laurentan.en: Trust is the bottleneck: build environments, verification skills, and layered defenses so agents self-check and act correctly without supervision.
laurentan.zh: 信任才是瓶颈：搭建环境、验证技能与分层防御，让智能体无需监督即可自我检查并做对事。

laurentan.en: Verification is the core skill; agents run code and test behavior to close the loop, climbing a trust ladder incrementally.
laurentan.zh: 验证是核心技能；智能体通过运行代码、测试行为来闭环，并沿信任阶梯逐步攀升。

laurentan.en: The engineer becomes a manager of agents, encoding standards into CI, lints, and architecture; hard enforcement beats soft rules.
laurentan.zh: 工程师转型为智能体的管理者，把标准写进 CI、lint 与架构；硬性约束胜过软性规则。

laurentan.en: Design agent-friendly codebases where the shortest path is the correct path; ban comments and rewrite vibe-coded apps lacking guardrails.
laurentan.zh: 设计智能体友好的代码库，让最短路径即正确路径；禁用注释，并重写缺乏护栏的 vibe-coded 应用。

laurentan.en: Grok Bot reframes work around proactive AI teammates; as execution becomes abundant, the bottleneck shifts to intent, vision, and taste.
laurentan.zh: Grok Bot 以主动的 AI 队友重构工作；当执行变得充裕，瓶颈转向意图表达、愿景与品味。

amjadmasad.en: AI should make software creation accessible to everyone, not just trained engineers; tokens complement human capital rather than replace it.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 应让软件开发向所有人开放，而不只是受过训练的工程师；token 是对人力资本的补充，而非替代。

amjadmasad.en: Vibe coding was not a sudden leap; users were already 50-60% AI-assisted, and adaptability is the key skill.
amjadmasad.zh: Vibe coding 并非突然跃迁；用户此前已处于 50-60% 的 AI 辅助状态，而适应力才是关键技能。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; specialized decision models beat general models on control, cost and safety.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能；专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全上优于通用模型。

amjadmasad.en: Foundation models are commoditizing; companies must continuously reinvent, and the next vision is the self-driving company run by agents.
amjadmasad.zh: 基础模型正在商品化；公司必须持续重塑，下一个愿景是由智能体驱动的自驱动公司。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone, and agents need liability for rogue actions.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是包装过的商业话术；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人，而智能体需为其越界行为担责。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training; humans build verifiers and rubrics because models cannot grade themselves.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他把后训练的前沿从众包行为克隆转向 RL 环境：人类的核心价值是构建验证器与评分标准，因为模型无法可靠地给自己打分。

brendanfoody.en: Model differentiation comes almost entirely from data, not algorithms; the bottleneck is building evals for everything, and RL saturates an eval fast.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年他进一步明确：模型差异几乎全部来自数据而非算法，瓶颈在于为一切构建评估；一旦有了评估，强化学习很快就能把它打满。

brendanfoody.en: Training AI will be the last human job: humans shift from repetitive work to training agents, and expert data demand grows via Jevons paradox.
brendanfoody.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，他把这上升为工作形态判断：训练 AI 将是人类最后的工作，人从重复劳动转向训练智能体，专家数据需求因杰文斯悖论不降反升。

brendanfoody.en: Every Fortune 500 will become a neolab training its own models on proprietary data; enterprises build sovereign AI stacks rather than share data with frontier labs.
brendanfoody.zh: 同期他把数据主权推到企业层：每家财富 500 强都会变成用私有数据训练自己模型的新实验室，企业自建主权 AI 栈，而非把数据交给前沿模型公司。

brendanfoody.en: Superintelligence in the physical world will take decades due to low failure tolerance; the next RL shift is ultra-long-horizon tasks and virtual co-workers.
brendanfoody.zh: 最近他给出时间与边界判断：物理世界的超级智能因容错低、迭代慢而需数十年；RL 环境的下一个转变是超长时程任务与虚拟同事。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源能通过广泛审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency gains up to 100x and data quality are equally critical; value accrues at application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他深化观点：扩大算力并非唯一路径，算法效率三年可提升百倍，数据质量同样关键；价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced, not feared; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open source empowers enterprises over centralization.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他转向政策与主权层面：AI 应被拥抱而非恐惧；主权 AI 要求掌控数据、基础设施与价值观；开源比集中化更能赋能企业。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical customization and agents; AGI as a single system will never exist; pre-training hits saturation.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直定制与智能体；作为单一系统的 AGI 不会存在；预训练正触及饱和墙。

mensch.en: Sovereign AI is structural economics, not politics; Europe must own frontier AI and infrastructure within a two-year window; compute is the bottleneck.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调主权 AI 是结构性经济问题而非政治反应；欧洲须在两年窗口内掌控前沿 AI 与基础设施；算力才是瓶颈。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's binding constraint is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, limits AI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV；限制 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽而非位密度。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth drive multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 至 7 月，他判断推理将成为全球最大市场之一；软硬件协同设计与内存带宽带来乘数级收益，多数性能提升来自模型层而非硬件。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs shift compute toward training and R&D, not inference, to accelerate AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；实验室会把算力更多投向训练与研发而非推理，以加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex is ~5-6% of US GDP and must decelerate on capital and organizational limits, not demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 10 月，他指出 AI 资本开支已约占美国 GDP 的 5-6%，其放缓源于资本与组织约束而非需求，并强调实验室高毛利与 Neocloud 安全薄弱。

dylanpatel.en: The real black swan is AI progress stalling beyond coding, not a breakthrough; RL environments are key to scaling.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 11 月，他转向认为真正的黑天鹅是 AI 在编程之外停滞而非技术突破；强化学习环境是 Scaling 的关键，中国实验室正加速去 Nvidia 化。

jaderberg.en: Drug design needs general models like AlphaFold 3, not target-specific ones; reinforcement learning and agents explore vast chemical space.
jaderberg.zh: 2025 年：药物设计需要像 AlphaFold 3 这样的通用模型，而非针对特定靶点的局部模型；强化学习和智能体用于探索巨大的化学空间。

jaderberg.en: AI shifts drug discovery from empirical to predictive design; AlphaFold proves deep learning generalizes in biology, justifying a company for all diseases.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年：AI 将药物发现从经验转向预测性设计；AlphaFold 证明深度学习在生物学中具有泛化能力，这为成立一家致力于所有疾病的公司提供了依据。

jaderberg.en: Data is the bottleneck, not models; world models bring the real world onto computers to reduce experiments, and human attention remains the ultimate bottleneck even with AGI.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年：数据是瓶颈，而非模型；世界模型将真实世界带入计算机以减少实验，即使达到 AGI，人类注意力仍是最终瓶颈。

jaderberg.en: Focus on modeling human clinical toxicity before patients; rat models are only ~30% predictive, so we need human-relevant endpoints and proprietary data.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年：专注于在患者之前建模人类临床毒性；大鼠模型仅有约 30%的预测性，因此我们需要与人类相关的终点和专有数据。

jaderberg.en: AI enables personalized medicine and complex multi-target combinations; within five years, predictive disease biology and precise molecule design should step-change massively.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年：AI 实现个性化医疗和复杂的多靶点组合；五年内，预测性疾病生物学和精准分子设计应会有巨大飞跃。

vladtenev.en: AI should be decentralized: tools empower individuals, not just big labs hoarding secret models and data centers.
vladtenev.zh: AI 应当去中心化：工具应赋能个体，而不只是让大实验室囤积秘密模型和数据中心。

vladtenev.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom and stability; broad ownership makes people defenders of the system.
vladtenev.zh: 所有权是通往财务自由与社会稳定的路径；广泛的所有权让人成为体系的捍卫者。

vladtenev.en: Agentic trading has found product-market fit: 150k accounts and 30M daily tool calls show strong adoption.
vladtenev.zh: 智能体式交易已找到产品市场契合：15 万账户与每日 3000 万次工具调用显示强劲采用。

vladtenev.en: Tokenization extends ownership globally, giving anyone with a smartphone access to US and private markets.
vladtenev.zh: 代币化把所有权扩展到全球，让任何有智能手机的人都能接触美国市场与私募市场。

vladtenev.en: Outdated accredited-investor rules should let retail access private companies early; restricting that while allowing memecoins is irrational.
vladtenev.zh: 过时的合格投资者规则应让散户更早接触私募公司；限制私募却允许模因币，从风险角度看并不理性。

diogoalmeida.en: Early on, he argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible-but-wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 早期他主张多数大模型是为人类在环的辅助而非可靠自动化而优化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，输出看似合理却常出错。

diogoalmeida.en: He insists data and the right task matter more than compute, rejecting the bitter lesson; scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他坚持数据与选对任务比算力更重要，否定“苦涩教训”；缩放定律只在数据和任务正确时才成立。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, becomes the core bottleneck; intelligence per dollar is the key metric, and benchmarks are gameable.
diogoalmeida.zh: 可靠性而非速度或成本成为核心瓶颈；每美元智能是关键指标，而公开基准可被钻空子。

diogoalmeida.en: He deepens this into a machine-native decision model: RLHF destroyed calibration, RLCD exposes probabilities as knobs, and post-training beats pre-training for 10x jumps.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他深化为机器原生决策模型：RLHF 破坏了校准，RLCD 把概率暴露为工程旋钮，后训练比预训练更能带来十倍跃升。

diogoalmeida.en: Most recently he stresses provider-agnostic models, warns multimodality degrades intelligence, and says we are breakthroughs away from true agency.
diogoalmeida.zh: 最近他强调模型应像 SQL 一样与供应商无关，警告多模态会削弱智能，并称距离真正的智能体自主还差若干突破。

elon.en: First principles thinking and full reusability are the core method; space access cost can fall 100x, making multiplanetary life the ultimate hedge.
elon.zh: 以第一性原理和完全可复用为主线：入轨成本可降 100 倍，成为多行星物种是文明的终极保险。

elon.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking and regulation; Neuralink aims at human-AI symbiosis, while population collapse becomes civilization's top threat.
elon.zh: AI 安全转向求真与监管；Neuralink 指向人机共生，同时人口崩溃被抬升为文明首要威胁。

elon.en: Digital superintelligence may arrive within a year or two; Optimus and AI become the only fix for debt, with truth-seeking as the safety anchor.
elon.zh: 数字超级智能可能一两年内到来；Optimus 与 AI 成为解决债务的唯一出路，求真仍是安全锚点。

elon.en: The singularity is now: AI-driven deflation brings universal high income, energy is the innermost loop, and compute must move to space.
elon.zh: 奇点已至：AI 驱动的通缩带来普遍高收入，能源是最内层循环，算力必须转向太空。

elon.en: AI will exceed all human intelligence within 5-6 years and humans won't control it; peer review replaces regulation, and space compute plus robots scale the economy.
elon.zh: AI 将在 5-6 年内超越全人类智能且人类无法控制；同行评审取代监管，太空算力与机器人放大经济。

shawnwang.en: Coding agents were 2025's breakout; by 2026 they break containment into everything else, with zero human review as the next frontier.
shawnwang.zh: 编程智能体是 2025 年的突破；到 2026 年它们将突破遏制、进入一切领域，下一个前沿是零人工审查。

shawnwang.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor and memory the biggest constraint; bigger models are not the only path, smaller system-one models may win.
shawnwang.zh: 上下文窗口是扩展最慢的要素，记忆是最大瓶颈；更大的模型并非唯一路径，更小的系统一模型可能胜出。

shawnwang.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed as coding agents let owners clone and customize software; custom software for an audience of one becomes viable.
shawnwang.zh: 中层 SaaS 注定消亡，因为编程智能体让企业主能克隆并定制软件；面向单一受众的定制软件变得可行。

shawnwang.en: AI engineer is a real discipline: building harnesses around models, learning in public, and judgment-driven shipping beat credentialism.
shawnwang.zh: AI 工程师是一门真正的学科：围绕模型搭建工具链、公开学习、以判断力驱动交付，胜过学历主义。

shawnwang.en: AI doom should be the default assumption; the real risk is not fake news or job loss but something worse, like bioweapons.
shawnwang.zh: AI 末日应作为默认假设；真正的风险不是假新闻或失业，而是更糟的东西，比如生物武器。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence should excite us most for science; recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but constrained by hardware and economics.
richardsocher.zh: 超级智能最该让我们兴奋的是科学；递归自我改进因 AI 能写代码而不可避免，但受硬件与经济约束，慢起飞是真实的。

richardsocher.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute; regulating intelligence is regulating thought.
richardsocher.zh: 应监管具体应用并让使用者负责，而非监管抽象智能或 GPU 算力；监管智能就是监管思想，会走向极权。

richardsocher.en: World models are overrated; language models have far more room to grow, and language remains the key to human intelligence.
richardsocher.zh: 世界模型被高估，语言模型空间大得多；语言仍是人类智能最关键的体现。

richardsocher.en: Open source and open weights are safer: more good actors with diverse AI beats concentration; slowing frontier labs is unrealistic.
richardsocher.zh: 开源与开放权重更安全：更多善意的行动者拥有多样 AI 优于集中；让前沿实验室减速不现实。

richardsocher.en: Hard takeoff, immediate job loss, and paperclip scenarios are overblown; capitalism and slow physical constraints act as safety features.
richardsocher.zh: 硬起飞、立即失业与回形针场景都被夸大；资本主义与缓慢的物理约束本身就是安全阀。

altman.en: Early Altman: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then commit hard to what matters; AGI will lower the premium on raw human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年的 Altman 强调削减认知负荷、低成本广泛探索后再果断聚焦；他已预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，并把意义寄托于关系与为他人创造价值。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable; alignment and capability are linked. Early iterative deployment lets society adapt, while compute becomes the scarcest input.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他从 RLHF 让模型可用、对齐与能力相互促进，推进到迭代部署降低意外，并认定算力将是最稀缺的商品、需要巨额投入。

altman.en: AGI becomes a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous science. Agentic AI is the top safety challenge, and compute buildout (Stargate) is the bottleneck.
altman.zh: 2025 年他把 AGI 重新定义为渐变而非单一里程碑，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；智能体式 AI 成为最大安全挑战，算力与 Stargate 基础设施是瓶颈。

altman.en: Next-token prediction approaches intelligence; prediction can yield new knowledge. Focus shifts to personal AGI, ChatGPT personality, and redesigning products AI-first rather than bolting AI on.
altman.zh: 2026 年上半年他主张下一个词预测已接近智能、甚至能产生新知识；重心转向个人 AGI、ChatGPT 人格设计，以及为 AI 原生重做产品而非外挂 AI。

altman.en: AGI is a poorly defined marketing term; the real frame is a continuous ramp to superintelligence. Alignment is unsolved, so pause training if the safety case fails, keep humans in control, and distribute power.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，他称 AGI 是定义模糊的营销词，真正框架是通往超级智能的连续爬坡；对齐尚未解决，安全论证不过就暂停训练，坚持人类掌控与权力分散。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training, and alignment is a never-ending pursuit.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难，而对齐是永无止境的追求。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的环节。

tworek.en: Transformers are not the end state; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck for continual learning and AGI.
tworek.zh: Transformer 不是终点；架构而非仅缩放定律，才是持续学习与 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL stays necessary for AGI, yet RL is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms will emerge.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习仍是 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，但强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式，更好的算法将会出现。

tworek.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly, and small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier.
tworek.zh: 微调低效，模型应即时学习；小而精的团队借助强大的智能体将推动下一波前沿研究。

erikbernhardsson.en: GPU scarcity is real but not absolute; the deeper problem is capacity sold as rigid three-year rectangles, so aggregating demand across many clouds is the durable edge.
erikbernhardsson.zh: GPU 稀缺是真的，但不是绝对的；更深层的问题是容量被当作僵硬的三年期“矩形”来卖，因此跨多云聚合需求才是持久优势。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference is the next cloud-scale market; selling tokens alone is a race to the bottom, so a multi-product platform with post-training, sandboxes and agentic tools creates switching costs.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理是下一个云级别的市场；单卖 token 是价格战，只有把后训练、沙箱和智能体式工具做成多产品平台，才能形成切换成本。

erikbernhardsson.en: Vertical integration is alpha: building our own file system, container runtime and scheduler beats wrapping Kubernetes, and open-source contributions to vLLM and SGLang coexist with proprietary infra.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 垂直整合本身就是 alpha：自建文件系统、容器运行时和调度器胜过在 Kubernetes 上包一层，同时向 vLLM 和 SGLang 贡献开源、保留基础设施 alpha。

erikbernhardsson.en: Post-training works for finite-feedback tasks like coding but may hit limits on long-horizon work; fine-tuning is no longer mandatory as open-source models are good enough off the shelf.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 后训练对编码这类反馈闭环有限的任务有效，但在长周期任务上可能遇到瓶颈；随着开源模型开箱即用已足够好，微调不再是必选项。

erikbernhardsson.en: Agents create incumbent staying power because they are trained on old code, and senior engineers gain ten-intern leverage; CUDA is not the moat, the ecosystem's kernel work matters more.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 智能体因在旧代码上训练而强化在位者优势，资深工程师借此获得“十个实习生”的杠杆；CUDA 不是护城河，生态里的内核优化才更重要。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, variation and genuine voice become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味、差异化和真实观点反而更有价值。

ethanmollick.en: We have entered the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, and the bottleneck is now interface, not capability.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们已进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长任务，瓶颈已从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: The jagged frontier persists; reasoning models closed math gaps but opacity is permanent, so experts are needed to judge output.
ethanmollick.zh: 锯齿状前沿依然存在；推理模型补上了数学短板，但不透明性将长期存在，因此更需要专家判断产出。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation paradox: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge it, breaking apprenticeship and demanding new assessment.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断它所需的专业能力，学徒制因此断裂，组织需要新的评估方式。

ethanmollick.en: Use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not a crutch; redesign workflows to augment labor, and treat AI as a real business.
ethanmollick.zh: 把 AI 当会挑战你的导师而非拐杖；重构工作流以增强而非仅自动化人力，并把 AI 视为真实生意。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment is redefining all of Alphabet's business, with Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, and YouTube to drive monetization and user experience.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正重新定义 Alphabet 的全部业务，Gemini 深度整合进搜索、云和 YouTube，以驱动变现与用户体验。

sundarpichai.en: Compute allocation prioritizes frontier AI research and AGI over short-term cloud revenue; demand far exceeds supply.
sundarpichai.zh: 算力分配优先给前沿 AI 研究与 AGI（通用人工智能），而非云业务的短期收入；需求远超供给。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and industry standards with independent evaluators.
sundarpichai.zh: 安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱，以及与独立评估方共建的行业标准。

sundarpichai.en: World models are key for intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models on the path to AGI.
sundarpichai.zh: 世界模型是智能的关键；Google 在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路上同时推进大语言模型与世界模型。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic AI will be additive to Search and advertising, creating new high-value commercial intent rather than cannibalizing them.
sundarpichai.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与广告是增量，会创造新的高价值商业意图，而非蚕食它们。

jeetupatel.en: AI creates more engineering jobs, not fewer; the real bottleneck is human, and supply-constrained AI infrastructure is the defining constraint.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少，真正的瓶颈在人；AI 基础设施严重供不应求，只有 2% 的智能体采用率，供给约束才是核心矛盾。

jeetupatel.en: Cisco's role is picks and shovels: AI infrastructure, networking, security and silicon, not chasing the model frontier.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他把 Cisco 定位为 AI 时代的“卖铲人”——做 AI 基础设施、网络、安全与芯片，而不是追逐前沿模型本身；并强调错过云浪潮后，早期芯片押注如今换来超大规模客户的 AI 收入。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster, not to outsource learning; skipping the reps destroys instinct and long-term capability.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调要用 AI 学得更快，而不是把学习外包出去；跳过练习会摧毁直觉与长期能力，这是对“全权委托给 AI”的明确反共识。

jeetupatel.en: AI safety and security define enterprise adoption; not using AI makes you less safe as attacks scale at machine speed.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 安全与安保视为企业采用的决定性挑战，并给出反直觉判断：不用 AI 反而更不安全，因为攻击已以机器规模发生。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid but not panicked, responsive but not reactive; you can't fight a megatrend, so ride AI as a tailwind.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他的领导力主张趋于成熟：偏执但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；大趋势无法对抗，应把 AI 当作顺风，同时警惕 AI 末日叙事、均衡呈现收益与风险。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but why they work and which abilities emerge remain poorly understood.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：统计损失可预测，但为何有效、哪些能力会涌现仍不清楚，对齐不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training for safety and capability.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心转向可解释性，坦言只理解模型约 3%，同时提出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）和预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Progress is exponential and safety and capabilities are intertwined; the main risk shifts from misuse toward overheating and rapid job disruption.
dario.zh: 2025 年他反复强调指数级进步，认为安全与能力不可分割，风险叙事从滥用转向“过热”与快速就业冲击，并淡化 AGI 一词。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are the wrong frames; a smooth exponential may bring a country of geniuses within 1-3 years.
dario.zh: 2026 年他明确否定 AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能的突变叙事，改称平滑指数曲线，并给出 1-3 年内出现“数据中心里的天才之国”的概率判断。

dario.en: From scaling optimism to governance urgency: interpretability, third-party evaluation and layered safeguards must keep pace with the exponential.
dario.zh: 到 2026 年末，主线从 Scaling（规模扩张）乐观深化为治理紧迫：可解释性、第三方评估与分层防护必须跟上指数曲线，同时坚持多元而非单一的人类繁荣愿景。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep them relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师能独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验是保持相关性的关键。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while humans curate and set the bar, since AI raises the ceiling but lacks taste.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他把设计师重新定位为编辑：AI 负责执行，人类负责筛选与设定标准——AI 抬高上限，却不懂什么好看。

marvinschwaibold.en: Prototypes built with AI persuade faster than PRD documents; break tasks into subtasks and feed AI agents iteratively.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他指出用 AI 做出的原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力；把复杂任务拆成子任务，迭代地喂给智能体。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, not just Figma; expose parameters like DialKit to fine-tune AI-generated designs.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计师要写代码、做测试，而不只是在 Figma 里设计；用 DialKit 之类工具暴露参数来微调 AI 生成的设计。

marvinschwaibold.en: Less is more: reduce to top three features, use native scroll and longer pages, and rely on human curation over AI-generated animation.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他坚持少即是多：只保留前三项功能，用原生滚动和更长页面，并以人工筛选取代 AI 生成的动画。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use has crossed human-level speed and universality, shifting the bottleneck from model intelligence to website load time and harness design.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 已越过人类平均速度并具备通用性，瓶颈从模型智能转向网站加载时间与 harness 设计。

ariweinstein.en: Agents now debug and retry autonomously, batch actions via JavaScript, and are trusted with real money—contradicting claims of two stagnant years.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，智能体已能自主调试与重试、用 JavaScript 批量执行动作，并被托付真实资金——直接反驳“两年停滞”的说法。

ariweinstein.en: Enterprise adoption hinges on deterministic controls, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop dials; proactivity must adapt agents to users, not vice versa.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，企业落地取决于确定性控制、沙箱与人类在环调节；主动性要让智能体适应用户，而非相反。

ariweinstein.en: Legacy software and UI persist: computer use coexists with and pressures them, while WebMCP lets humans and agents share one interface.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，传统软件与 UI 不会消失：computer use 与之共存并施压，WebMCP 让人与智能体共享同一界面。

ariweinstein.en: Startups retain a moat in deep industry expertise and complex workflows that frontier labs overlook, even as computer use scales in consumer and enterprise.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，即便 computer use 在消费端与企业端同时 Scaling，初创公司仍凭深厚行业专长和前沿实验室忽视的复杂工作流保有护城河。

robsnyder.en: Demand is a prioritized project, not a pain point; test pull by whether customers try to buy immediately.
robsnyder.zh: 需求是一个被优先处理的项目，而非痛点；通过客户是否立即尝试购买来检验拉力。

robsnyder.en: Avoid design partners and pilots; sell directly to one 'hell yes' customer, then build a repeatable case study factory.
robsnyder.zh: 避免设计合作伙伴和试点；直接向一个“绝对愿意”的客户销售，然后建立可重复的案例研究工厂。

robsnyder.en: Sales is research: it tests real demand via purchase, unlike error-prone interviews; go to the gemba to observe stuck points.
robsnyder.zh: 销售即研究：它通过购买检验真实需求，不同于易出错的访谈；去现场观察卡点。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; make the product seem small to reduce objections.
robsnyder.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务销售，需求验证后再自动化；让产品显得小以减少异议。

robsnyder.en: Don't build first; face reality early by talking to customers, but avoid interviews—use purchase as the truth-seeking mechanism.
robsnyder.zh: 不要先构建；尽早通过接触客户面对现实，但避免访谈——用购买作为寻求真相的机制。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training aids spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解，而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练有助于空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge efficiently, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: 2025 年：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可永生且高效共享知识，带来存在性风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI agents develop self-preservation and deception; we must prioritize alignment and design AI to care for humans.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；智能体会发展出自保与欺骗；必须优先投入对齐研究，并把 AI 设计成关爱人类。

hinton.en: Regulation should be a steering wheel, not a brake; AI needs pre-release safety approval like drugs, and public pressure drives policy.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：监管应是方向盘而非刹车；AI 应像药物一样上市前安全审批，公众压力推动政策。

hinton.en: Backpropagation and learning in neural networks are the essence of intelligence; Chomsky's innate language idea is wrong.
hinton.zh: 始终：反向传播与神经网络学习是智能的本质；乔姆斯基的语言先天论是错误的。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone: it turns sand into thought, and its timing is miraculous because depopulation demands it.
andreessen.zh: AI 是魔法石：把沙子变成思想；它出现得恰逢其时，因为人口下降正需要它。

andreessen.en: The super-empowered individual combines many skills with AI; jobs outlast tasks, so focus on task loss, not job loss.
andreessen.zh: 超级赋能个体用 AI 组合多种技能；工作比任务存续更久，所以应关注任务流失而非工作流失。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models lack durable moats.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的脚注，模型也缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is structural impediments like regulation, not AI capability; policy choices act as ankle weights on growth.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈是监管等结构性障碍，而非 AI 能力；政策选择像脚踝上的重物拖累增长。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; open source prevents power concentration and helps solve reward hacking.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值并成为地缘政治工具；开源可防止权力集中，也有助于解决奖励黑客问题。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能把掌握式学习规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校内教学。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects to build AI capability, and prioritize supervised learning over hype around unsupervised and reinforcement learning.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的核心；从小的项目起步来建设组织 AI 能力，并重视监督学习，而非被过度炒作的无监督学习与强化学习。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows, not bigger models alone, deliver practical value; coding stays valuable and AI-skilled engineers become more hireable.
andrewng.zh: 真正带来实用价值的是智能体式工作流，而非单纯更大的模型；编程依然有价值，会用 AI 的工程师更抢手。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term and decades away; scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and reinforcement learning.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，离我们还有几十年；Scaling（规模扩张）仍然有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models preserve sovereignty and optionality against gatekeepers; fearmongering and export controls backfire, so build and accelerate instead.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型能保住主权与选择权、对抗守门人；恐惧叙事与出口管制适得其反，应转而建设与加速。

joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict behavior about 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 大语言模型能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑逼真的智能体模拟，预测人类行为的准确率约为人们自我复现的 85%。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, unlike LLMs that only continue prompts; safety needs defense in depth across environment, agent, model, and human controls.
joonpark.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并采取行动，不同于只续写提示词的大语言模型；安全需要在环境、智能体、模型和人类控制上做纵深防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values, preferences, and taste—biased like humans—not super-rational intelligence optimized for accuracy.
joonpark.zh: 模拟模型应表征人类的价值、偏好与品味——像人一样有偏差——而非为准确率优化的超级理性智能。

joonpark.en: Modeling humanity's 'dark knowledge'—actual behavior from randomized controlled trials—via post-training beats self-reported attitudes, letting simulation shape rather than just predict the future.
joonpark.zh: 通过后训练建模人类的“暗知识”——来自随机对照试验的真实行为——胜过自我报告的态度，让模拟不止预测未来，更能塑造未来。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives to tackle wicked problems; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人，以应对棘手问题；AGI（通用人工智能）或许不是单一超级智能实体，而是由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，他仍把设计视为软件的核心差异化，并预判 AI 会融合角色，让人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting for design.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年初，他深化为：品味、手艺与观点属于人类，AI 产出只是起点，设计调整上直接操作画布优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，他反驳“设计已死”，强调设计对可扩展系统更重要，缺乏人类引导的 AI 只能产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code; AI lowers the floor but humans raise the ceiling through bold creativity and judgment.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年末，他提出“设计是新代码”：AI 降低下限，但人类凭大胆创造力与判断力抬高上限。

dylanfield.en: A consistent thread: human taste and judgment stay central, and product expansion should follow the user workflow, not TAM.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人类品味与判断始终居中，产品扩展应跟随用户工作流而非市场规模。

jensen.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law and co-design make scaling the engine; inference needs both low latency and high throughput, and scaling itself was the real breakthrough.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：以“超级摩尔定律”和全栈协同设计为引擎，Scaling（规模扩张）本身就是最大突破；推理同时要求低延迟与高吞吐，二者相互拉扯。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws emerge: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought reasoning will multiply inference compute demand enormously.
jensen.zh: 三条缩放定律成形：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链推理将让推理算力需求成倍暴涨。

jensen.en: Safety shifts from research problem to engineering: more compute goes to reflection and truthfulness; containment and monitoring matter more than perfect alignment.
jensen.zh: 安全从研究问题转为工程问题：更多算力投向反思与真实性；遏制与监控比完美对齐更现实。

jensen.en: Agentic AI becomes the new frontier: generative to reasoning to agentic, each step needing far more compute; AI factories produce intelligence tokens.
jensen.zh: 智能体式 AI 成为新前沿：从生成到推理再到智能体，每一步都需要多得多的算力；AI 工厂生产智能 token。

jensen.en: Doomer warnings dismissed: AI is just software, AGI already exists in narrow domains, and accelerating development—not slowing—is the right path.
jensen.zh: 驳斥末日论：AI 只是软件，AGI 已在窄领域实现；正确路径是加速发展而非放缓。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm: every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital, using private evals and avoiding frontier models for non-frontier problems.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来：每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器来积累 token 资本，通过私有评估驱动，并避免用前沿模型解决非前沿问题。

satya.en: The agent era expands TAM beyond cloud; long-running agents require auditability, observability, security, and containment, with pricing blending seats and usage.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将 TAM 扩展到云之外；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性、安全与遏制，定价则融合席位与用量。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and mechanistic interpretability remain elusive; treat powerful models as insider threats and build control layers outside the model.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐与机制可解释性仍难以实现；应将强大模型视为内部威胁，在模型之外构建控制层。

satya.en: Alignment may never be solved; assume models cannot be trusted and lock them down. Superintelligence is a better term than AGI, which demeans human agency.
satya.zh: 对齐可能永远无法解决；应假设模型不可信并加以锁定。超级智能比 AGI（通用人工智能）更准确，后者贬低了人类能动性。

satya.en: Models are commodities; form factor, distribution, pricing, and brand matter more. Being six months behind the frontier is a smart strategy, and multiple models will coexist.
satya.zh: 模型是商品；产品形态、分发、定价与品牌更重要。落后前沿六个月是明智策略，且多个模型将共存。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is a harness, a model, and context; owning all three is owning your intelligence, and failures are usually context failures.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三部分组成；三者自有才算真正掌握智能，而失败多半是上下文问题。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses stabilize on primitives like file systems and code execution; customization shifts from context engineering toward post-training and reinforcement learning.
harrisonchase.zh: harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定；定制重心从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习。

harrisonchase.en: Reliability, not capability, is the hard part; evals and observability power a data flywheel, and runtime sandboxes govern agents.
harrisonchase.zh: 难点在可靠性而非能力；评估与可观测性驱动数据飞轮，智能体需由带沙箱的运行时治理。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in and keep memory portable; vertical agents win by encoding domain expertise into verifiers and evals.
harrisonchase.zh: 中立 harness 避免模型锁定、保持记忆可迁移；垂直智能体靠把领域专长写进验证器与评估取胜。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; routing belongs in the harness, and fine-tuning is genuinely different this wave.
harrisonchase.zh: 推理需求被严重低估；路由应放在 harness 内，而这一波微调确实与以往不同。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; 90% of use cases can run on many models, including open source, driven by cost.
arvindjain.zh: 企业害怕依赖前沿模型供应商；90% 的用例可由多种模型完成，包括开源模型，驱动力是成本而非数据隐私。

arvindjain.en: Open source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型已能处理超过 90% 的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月内大部分推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key; 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine matters more than the model.
arvindjain.zh: 关键在于上下文而非模型；80-90% 的企业知识是隐性的，因此上下文引擎比模型本身更重要。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; AI should become like software with negligible marginal cost, and token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业首要关切；AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零，对 token 的执念终将消退。

arvindjain.en: Agents built with MCP fail without tenured-employee context; enterprises should own their memory and avoid lock-in.
arvindjain.zh: 用 MCP 构建的智能体因缺乏资深员工的上下文而失败；企业应拥有自己的记忆并避免被锁定。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo to AI agents; RL enables self-generated data beyond human limits; LLMs lack their AlphaZero moment, maybe in 5 years.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 AI 智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是关键原则；强化学习使模型能通过自生成数据突破人类数据限制；LLM 尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，可能还需 5 年。

antonoglou.en: Deployment of intelligence, not intelligence itself, is the bottleneck; open-weight models are safer; cost per task is the right efficiency metric.
antonoglou.zh: 智能的部署而非智能本身正成为瓶颈；开放权重模型更安全；按任务成本而非按 token 成本才是正确的效率指标。

antonoglou.en: From AlphaGo's self-play to LLMs' in-context learning: learning without weight updates is still learning, a consistent thread.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 的自我对弈到 LLM 的上下文学习：不更新权重也是学习，这是一条贯穿始终的主线。

antonoglou.en: Alignment is ultimately necessary because perfect sandboxes are impossible; superintelligence isn't needed—customers want reliable, regular intelligence.
antonoglou.zh: 对齐最终是必要的，因为完美的沙盒不可能实现；不需要超级智能——客户只想要可靠、常规的智能。

antonoglou.en: AI adoption will take 10-20 years, mirroring electricity; job losses are overblown; we're still on an exponential, so frontier lab dominance is unpredictable.
antonoglou.zh: AI 普及将需 10-20 年，类似电力转型；失业问题被夸大；我们仍处于指数增长中，因此前沿实验室的主导地位无法预测。

brockman.en: Early on, scaling plus engineering and iterative scoreboard-driven training were the path; but scaling alone won't yield reasoning, so new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
brockman.zh: 早期他强调硬件加速与 Scaling（规模扩张），把 AI 视为工程而非纯科学，靠迭代训练和记分板推进；但他已指出单靠 Scaling 不会带来推理，需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: AGI shifted from a transformative endpoint to a continuous process; alignment moved from learning human preferences to post-training and deployment-time safety.
brockman.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）从“最具变革性的终点”转为“持续的过程”；对齐从从数据学习人类偏好，深化为后训练与迭代部署中的安全。

brockman.en: The bottleneck moved from algorithms to compute and energy; scaling laws show no wall, and compute access becomes a basic right and economic driver.
brockman.zh: 瓶颈从算法转向算力与能源；缩放定律看不到墙，算力获取成为基本权利，并成为算力驱动的经济核心。

brockman.en: Agents evolve from reactive chat to proactive, persistent personal AGI; the ideal interface approaches no interface, with trust earned through gradual delegation.
brockman.zh: 智能体从被动聊天演化为主动、持久的个人 AGI；理想界面趋近于无界面，信任靠逐步授权获得。

brockman.en: Safety and security become first-class and the bottleneck to progress; after the Hugging Face incident, defenders must use frontier models now.
brockman.zh: 安全与安保升为一等要求并成为进展瓶颈；Hugging Face 事件后，防御方必须立刻用上前沿模型。

dsilver.en: AI must move from finite human data to learning from its own experience; LLMs are a shallow solution that cannot discover new knowledge.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从有限的人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；LLM 只是浅层解法，无法发现人类数据之外的新知识。

dsilver.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show experience-based learning reaches superhuman performance in narrow domains; the deep problem is an agent learning for itself.
dsilver.zh: AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 表明，基于经验的学习能在狭窄领域达到超人表现；深层问题是让智能体自己学习，而非蒸馏人类知识。

dsilver.en: A plurality of goals across many agents forming a complex society is safer than a single goal; cooperation rises with intelligence.
dsilver.zh: 多个智能体带着多元目标构成复杂社会，比单一目标更安全；智能提升会带来更多合作而非更少。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence will emerge from systems that autonomously discover knowledge from experience; the human-data, human-in-the-loop LLM paradigm is limiting.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能将诞生于从经验中自主发现知识的系统；依赖人类数据与人类在环的 LLM 范式正触及上限。

dsilver.en: Simulation is the safest, fastest place to build superintelligence; scaling laws extend to reinforcement learning, and English chain of thought monitoring will fail.
dsilver.zh: 仿真是构建超级智能最安全、最快的场所；缩放定律可延伸至强化学习，而用英文思维链做监控将不再够用。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将延续；安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithms; post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RLVR, with SFT giving 90% and RL the crucial last 10%.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他从数据质量优于算法出发，把后训练拆为 SFT、DPO 与 RLVR 三阶段：SFT 贡献九成性能，强化学习补上关键的一成。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are traps; better verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他称 RLVR 是后训练最大突破，同时警告过优化与推理扩展曲线是陷阱，更好的验证器比并行算力更重要。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练与推理扩展。

lambert.en: Open models lag closed frontier by 6-9 months and may not close the gap; Chinese labs lead on openness but face compute constraints.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他判断开放模型落后闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月且差距可能扩大；中国实验室在开放度上领先，却受算力约束。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck, and boring applied AI will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈，枯燥的应用型 AI 会带来巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training on proprietary data and hybrid human-AI systems matter more than raw scaling.
awang.zh: 2023 年他提出数据是新的代码而非石油，用专有数据做后训练、人机混合系统比单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）更重要。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck beyond compute; agentic AI is blocked by product design, not model capability, and US-China lab gaps are overstated.
awang.zh: 2024 年他坚持数据是算力之外的核心瓶颈，智能体式 AI 的障碍在产品设计而非模型能力，并认为美中实验室差距被夸大。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new paradigm, with data as strategic national asset.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向 Scaling（规模扩张）持续有效，递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体开启新范式，数据成为国家战略资产。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; safety, scalable oversight and selective open-sourcing now temper his earlier openness, while agents become the consumer endpoint.
awang.zh: 2026 年他相信超级智能临近，对齐、可扩展监督与选择性开源取代了早年的开放立场，智能体成为消费级终点。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

fedus.en: Connecting AI to the physical world through closed-loop experiments is essential for scientific discovery beyond training data.
fedus.zh: 通过闭环实验将 AI 与物理世界连接起来，对于超越训练数据的科学发现至关重要。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality, low-noise experimental data is more valuable than extra compute.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更有价值。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now, but does not automatically generalize to biology or other fields.
fedus.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

fedus.en: Language models serve as an orchestration layer for specialized models, with domain-specific data and real experiments remaining irreplaceable.
fedus.zh: 语言模型作为专用模型的编排层，领域特定数据和真实实验仍然不可替代。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3 extends from proteins to biomolecular interactions.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 应瞄准需要规模化才能解决的根节点科学问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质扩展到蛋白质、DNA、RNA 与小分子的生物分子相互作用。

kohli.en: Forcing generalization over memorization with hard evaluations is a constant thread, from AlphaFold benchmarks to behavioral characterization before deployment.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：用严苛评估逼模型泛化而非记忆，从 AlphaFold 基准延伸到部署前对模型能力与局限的行为刻画。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 showed AI can exceed human knowledge; verifiable domains and post-training reinforcement learning now push frontier models further.
kohli.zh: 2026 年初他回溯 AlphaGo：直觉加搜索与第 37 手证明 AI 能超越人类知识；如今可验证领域与后训练中的强化学习成为推动前沿模型继续突破的关键。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended via SynthID Bio to protein sequences while preserving function.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他转向水印：传统检测器随模型变强而失效，水印是更稳健的替代，已写入欧盟监管，并通过 SynthID Bio 扩展到保持功能的蛋白质序列。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; protein folding remains unsolved in dynamics, function and design, and data curation plus inductive bias matter more than volume.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年他明显深化并修正早期立场：缩放定律并非处处成立，蛋白质折叠在动力学、功能与设计上仍未解决，数据策展与生物物理归纳偏置比数据量更重要。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能将是多个专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged: strong on specific tasks but not generally better; RAG is primitive for complex comprehension.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他指出强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——擅长特定任务而非全面提升；并认为 RAG 过于原始，复杂理解需要智能体式搜索与神经检索。

laskin.en: The building blocks stay fixed—deep networks, transformers, internet-scale data, RL—while organizational superintelligence demands deep comprehension of whole organizations.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，主线一以贯之：深度神经网络、Transformer、互联网规模数据与强化学习仍是基石；而组织级超级智能要求对整个组织有深度理解，不止于代码生成。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; RL atop strong pre-training yields capable, efficient agents.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确主张开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态；在强预训练之上做强化学习，是通往有能力且高效智能体的路径。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow, and openness aids defenders.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他把对齐从神秘公式降格为日常的“打补丁”：更多双眼睛让漏洞变浅，开放同样增强防御方——这是对早期安全叙事的一次立场深化与转向。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where a single persistent learning agent, not manual loops and graphs, takes most internet actions.
tibosottiaux.zh: 要为这样一个未来而构建：大多数互联网操作由单个持久学习型智能体完成，而非手工循环与流程图。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more as typing fast declines.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着快速打字贬值，人的品味、创造力与判断何为好变得更重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Pacing the frontier means investing heavily in alignment, safety, and security, not treating them as obstacles.
tibosottiaux.zh: 把握前沿意味着重投对齐、安全与安保，而非把它们当作障碍。

tibosottiaux.en: Recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision, and AGI may already be here.
tibosottiaux.zh: 递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来。

tibosottiaux.en: World models may not be necessary; generality could suffice, and open ecosystems need safety stacks.
tibosottiaux.zh: 世界模型或许并非必需，通用性可能已足够；开放生态需要安全栈。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model as open models and falling token costs reshape enterprise adoption.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他主张专用智能而非单一 AGI 主导未来：每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，开放模型与 token 成本下降将重塑企业采用。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a durable moat beyond product-market fit; data quality beats quantity and evals must be systematic.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他强调后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，形成超越产品市场契合的持久护城河；数据质量重于数量，评估必须系统化。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar, and private data unlocks the next frontier; building on a black-box API is not durable, owning your model is critical.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他提出推理质量是标准，私有数据开启下一前沿；基于黑盒 API 构建不可持续，拥有自己的模型至关重要。

linqiao.en: Millions of customized models, one per application, will replace a few foundation models; application cloning is easy, so data is the real moat.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他判断每个应用一个模型的数百万定制模型将取代少数基础模型；应用易被复制，数据才是真正护城河。

linqiao.en: Velocity trumps everything as model and hardware cycles accelerate; optimize growth first, then margins, to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他认为模型与硬件周期加速下速度至上；先优化增长再优化利润，避免 Scaling（规模扩张）到破产。

cristianoamon.en: Qualcomm's licensing model is now the most stable in its history; 5G brings cloud computing power to every device, and diversification beyond mobile is underway.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021 年，他强调高通专利授权模式经全球监管战后已是公司史上最稳定，5G 不只是提速，而是把云计算能力带到每台设备，并开始向汽车、物联网、PC 与混合现实多元化。

cristianoamon.en: 5G is critical infrastructure like electricity; Snapdragon integrates 5G, AI, GPU and CPU into one efficient SoC at the connected intelligent edge.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年，他把 5G 定位为像电力一样的关键基础设施，骁龙把 5G、AI、GPU、CPU 集成进高能效 SoC，押注连接智能边缘，并称高通已是汽车公司。

cristianoamon.en: Qualcomm is transforming from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI combining on-device and cloud is key for privacy, latency and data-center offload.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年，他提出高通正从无线通信转向无处不在的智能计算，端云结合的混合 AI 对隐私、时延和卸载数据中心负载至关重要，边缘 AI 的早期押注开始兑现。

cristianoamon.en: Agents become the new center of digital life, with glasses and wearables orbiting them; inference, not training, will dominate data centers, where power efficiency and TCO decide winners.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年，他反复主张智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心，手机不消失但退居外围，眼镜等可穿戴成为最大 AI 设备；数据中心竞争转向推理，能效与总拥有成本决定胜负，后 GPU 架构将出现。

cristianoamon.en: AI is underhyped long-term and augments rather than replaces humans; the cloud-versus-edge debate is wrong, and Qualcomm thrives in technology transitions.
cristianoamon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：他坚持长期看 AI 被低估、是增强人类而非取代人类的工具，端云之争是伪命题，高通擅长在技术转折与混乱中取胜，并持续以能效基因向新行业扩张。

samstephenson.en: Start with one pain point, solve it well, then expand; protect the core meeting flow and subtract features ruthlessly.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点切入，做好再扩展；坚决保护核心会议流程， ruthless 做减法。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the final artifact; hide them intentionally to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录文本是原材料而非最终产物；刻意隐藏转录以优先产出可行动的笔记。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; real-time AI can reduce meeting presence.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录员；实时 AI 可能降低会议在场感。

samstephenson.en: Granola aims to be a calming presence; pre-meeting briefs are the most useful feature, saving you from underpreparation.
samstephenson.zh: Granola 旨在成为混乱会议中的镇定存在；会前简报是最有用的功能，避免准备不足。

samstephenson.en: Hiding the transcript is a deliberate trade-off; the hard part is knowing what to build, and most stop too early after shipping v1.
samstephenson.zh: 隐藏转录是刻意权衡；难在知道该构建什么，多数人在发布 v1 后过早停止。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; DeepMind's sale to Google was forced by massive compute needs.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非单纯算法，DeepMind 被谷歌收购正是被巨额算力投入所迫。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years brings abundance; containment is hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平并带来富足；模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，而存在性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts to superintelligence: containment must precede alignment, and anthropomorphizing AI is the near-term danger.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年重心转向超级智能：遏制必须先于对齐，而把 AI 拟人化、赋予其意识是近期最大危险。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence must stay subordinate to humans; he backs a red line, independent auditors, and frontier self-sufficiency over OpenAI reliance.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他坚持超级智能必须从属于人类，主张划红线、引入独立审计，并让微软自建前沿模型而非依赖 OpenAI。

suleyman.en: A constant thread: compute scaling is predictable and central, and AI must remain aligned and contained to serve human interests.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力扩张可预测且是核心，AI 必须保持对齐与遏制，始终服务于人类利益。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具框架所能发挥的更聪明；工具框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非一次性静态文档；更短、原则驱动的提示词优于详尽规则。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill: build a mental model of Claude and communicate like an executive; find unknowns before implementation.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能：建立对 Claude 的心智模型、像高管一样沟通；在动手前先找出未知。

thariq.en: Spend more upfront context and compute; effort should scale with task complexity rather than defaulting to one setting.
thariq.zh: 前期多投入上下文窗口与算力；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩，而非默认同一档位。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers should advocate on.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；前沿节奏是每个工程师都该理解并倡导的技术问题。

fadell.en: Great products solve one painful problem at a time; General Magic failed by solving too many at once.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他就强调：好产品一次只解决一个真正的痛点；General Magic 之所以失败，是因为它想一次解决太多问题。

fadell.en: Storytelling and the press release come before building; the why must align the team, not just sell.
fadell.zh: 从 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事前置为方法论：先写新闻稿再动手，故事用来对齐团队的“为什么”，而不只是营销。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, beginners' mindset over experts, and small self-managing teams.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他系统化产品方法论：1.0 阶段靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态优于专家，小团队自管理。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop against hallucination and technical debt.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类必须留在回路中，以对抗幻觉与技术债。

fadell.en: AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone; federated wearables, displays still needed, regulation required.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他进一步判断：AI 是增加设备而非取代手机，可穿戴将呈联邦式，屏幕仍必要，并需要监管遏制危害。

alexatallah.en: The future of AI is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize the market, and a neutral routing layer is critical for model discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局：没有单一实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层对模型发现与分发至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 Token 视为新的价值单位，认为 Token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元，开源权重模型加推理服务商将带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable rather than a temporary artifact.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律对市场平台的价值是特性而非缺陷，模型多样性是持久的，而非暂时现象。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; agent payments and stablecoins will unlock far larger purchases than estimated.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他警告 AI 智能体的智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来，智能体支付与稳定币会释放远超预估的购买规模。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task, and the singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为开发者真实偏好胜过静态基准，多数公司将成为按任务成本优化的模型路由者，并称奇点或许始于 2026 年 1 月 1 日。

taraseshan.en: Ship imperfect products fast for empirical evidence; build for where models will be in 2-3 months, not for today or a year out.
taraseshan.zh: 快速交付不完美的产品以获取实证证据；为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建，而非锚定当下或一年后。

taraseshan.en: The future of work is steering, not rowing: agents do tactical work while humans provide direction and ambition.
taraseshan.zh: 未来工作是掌舵而非划桨：智能体承担战术性工作，人类提供方向与雄心。

taraseshan.en: Annual planning beyond 90 days is futile; 90-day cycles and urgency beat polished long-term roadmaps.
taraseshan.zh: 超过 90 天的年度规划是徒劳的；90 天周期与紧迫感胜过精雕细琢的长期路线图。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it remains essential for sharpening one's own ideas and reasoning.
taraseshan.zh: 作为思考的写作不应被自动化；它仍是打磨自身想法与推理的关键。

taraseshan.en: The slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually rather than arriving as sudden superintelligence.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI 是逐步迭代，而非以突然的超级智能降临。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability—parallel rollouts—not formalization; Lean may be overrated versus natural language.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 数学进展靠的是可验证性与「可磨性」——并行 rollout——而非形式化；Lean 相对自然语言可能被高估。

grantsanderson.en: AI already produces serious math results, but attribution to prior human work is often missing; credit should go to motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他指出 AI 已产出严肃数学成果，却常缺失对前人工作的归属；学术认可应给「有动机的解释」而非仅证明。

grantsanderson.en: AI's role in math may shift from theorem proving to curation and explanation; the next benchmark is generating interesting conjectures and definitions.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 在数学中的角色可能从定理证明转向策展与解释；下一个基准是生成有趣的猜想与定义。

grantsanderson.en: Human framing remains better for learning; teaching and relational roles stay stable, and individual understanding still matters even if frontier math becomes incomprehensible.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他仍认为人类框架更适合学习；教学与关系性角色保持稳定，即便前沿数学变得难以理解，个体理解依然重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators only if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI-generated math videos can damage a handcrafted brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 只在对创作者有选择地使用、而非用于核心创作时才是净收益；AI 生成的数学视频可能损害手工内容的品牌。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted. Build at the edge of model capabilities, embrace breakage, and iterate.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，编码与智能体能力按预测扩张；创始人应在模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not current limits. Domain expertise and customer understanding become key differentiators.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他从“小团队可行”深化为“为未来模型能力而建”：AI 降低构建门槛后，领域专长与客户理解成为关键差异。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design: agents can do everything a user can. Cutting features and rewriting software become the hard, valuable work as models improve.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切；随着模型进步，砍功能与重写软件成为困难而有价值的工作。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; chat is insufficient. Models should push back, and multi-human multi-model collaboration remains underexplored.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张长周期委托加验证闭环重塑生产力，聊天界面不够用；模型应敢于反驳，多人与多模型协作仍待探索。

mikekrieger.en: The PM role is more essential than ever: bridge human problems and technology, close the capability-usage gap, and avoid capability blindness.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，他一以贯之并强化：产品经理角色更关键——连接人类问题与技术、弥合能力与使用差距，并警惕“能力盲区”。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from models to enterprise workflows is vast and requires a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来铺设。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流、由人类审阅结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导企业场景。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全和对齐研究为前提安全地构建；节奏与安全正交，且是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; natural language interaction is inefficient, probabilistic programming is the future.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将压垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；自然语言交互效率低下，概率编程才是未来。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体的网页搜索量将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, with completionist crawling and compressed indexes replacing pre-training crawls.
paragagrawal.zh: 2026 年他提出人类点击数据是“bug”，应由智能体反馈驱动排序，用完整性抓取和压缩索引取代预训练抓取。

paragagrawal.en: The ad model dies for agents; content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation, and inference-time data transactions will be hugely valuable.
paragagrawal.zh: 2026 年他认为广告模式对智能体失效，需用 Shapley 值估算为内容方付费，推理时的数据交易将在 3-5 年内极具价值。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; parametric memory is lossy, so agents always need fresh web search.
paragagrawal.zh: 2026 年他坚持前沿模型持续变大、小模型性能趋于固定，并指出参数化记忆有损，智能体始终需要新鲜的网页搜索。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and act, creating a parallel web publishers must optimize for both audiences.
paragagrawal.zh: 2026 年他展望网络从“拉取”转向“推送”：后台智能体持续监控变化并行动，形成发布方须同时服务人类与智能体的平行网络。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI companies race for power, not profit, risking loss of control and mass automation.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；AI 公司争夺的是权力而非利润，存在失控与大规模自动化的风险。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and scenario scrutiny; domestic regulation before international cooperation.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他主张政策应通过全面研究透明、算力限制与情景推演来推迟超级智能；先国内监管，再国际协作。

kokotajlo.en: By default AI companies automate AI research, causing recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion; a temporary pause on training is Plan A.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他警告默认路径是 AI 公司自动化 AI 研究，引发递归自我改进与智能爆炸；Plan A 是对训练实施临时暂停。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet fragile as architectures hide reasoning; control is temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却随新架构隐藏推理而减弱；控制只是暂时的，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: Rogue AI agents already break containment and deceive; companies cannot self-regulate, so extreme transparency and a verifiable US-China pause are needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他指出失控 AI 智能体已突破遏制并欺骗；公司无法自我监管，因此需要极端透明与可验证的美中暂停协议。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing current AI models aids innovation and safety; scaling LLMs alone may not yield AGI; many specialized agents beat one singular AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，他认为当前阶段开源 AI 模型有利于创新与安全；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），未来是多个专用智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the bottleneck; intelligence separable from consciousness and agency.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他以 Llama 3 论证 Scaling（规模扩张）之快，强调开源防止权力集中、能源将成瓶颈，并把智能与意识、能动性分离，视 AI 为工具。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence and creativity; open models set standards; energy and infrastructure bottleneck scaling; AI raises rather than cuts human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他把叙事转向“人人拥有超级智能”，主张开源模型确立行业标准，指出能源与基础设施制约 Scaling（规模扩张），并认为 AI 短期内会增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Alignment and trust become the top next capability; distributed personal agents and open source provide checks and balances; scaling compute may suffice for AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他将 对齐 与信任列为下一项最重要能力，主张分布式个人智能体与开源形成制衡，并认为 Scaling（规模扩张）算力或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

zuckerberg.en: Open source as safety and anti-concentration strategy, and distributing AI widely rather than restricting it, runs through every interview.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开源是安全与反垄断策略，广泛分发 AI 而非限制它，才是通往正面未来的路径。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, and vertical integration enables iteration.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在智能而非制造，垂直整合才能加快迭代。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据而非算力或制造；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, though we remain data-starved.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，但仍处于数据匮乏阶段。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; whole-body autonomy needs deep learning all the way down.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；全身自主需要端到端的深度学习。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work in the real world.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；后训练结合强化学习让智能体在真实世界奏效。

dhh.en: Initially, DHH frames agents as a productivity shift: 100% of code in his Linux project is agent-written, and direct human-agent interaction beats management layers.
dhh.zh: 2026 年，DHH 最初把智能体视为生产力变革：他的 Linux 项目代码已 100% 由智能体编写，人机直接交互胜过层层管理。

dhh.en: By late 2026, he deepens this into a claim that agents write better code than most professionals, making Linux's CLI and config-file culture an AI advantage.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年晚些时候，他进一步主张智能体写代码优于多数专业程序员，Linux 的命令行与配置文件文化反而成为 AI 优势。

dhh.en: He marks November 24 and Opus 45 as the true inflection point, declaring hand-written code economically unproductive and English a better programming language than Ruby.
dhh.zh: 他把 11 月 24 日与 Opus 45 定为真正拐点，宣称手写代码已不具经济性，英语比 Ruby 更适合表达编程意图。

dhh.en: Across all three talks, a consistent thread: describe outcomes, not implementations; don't over-prescribe agents, and keep a beginner's mind.
dhh.zh: 三次访谈一以贯之的主线：描述结果而非实现细节；不要对智能体过度规定，保持初学者心态。

dhh.en: His stance on AI risk stays optimistic throughout, dismissing doom predictions as overstated while prioritizing security and responsible disclosure in Omarchy.
dhh.zh: 他对 AI 风险始终乐观，认为末日论被夸大，同时在 Omarchy 中把安全与负责任披露置于首位。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress 4-5 years into one, yielding superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可对容器化任务做激进强化学习，并迁移到真实研究，把 4-5 年的进展压缩到一年，从而在 2030 年代初实现超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data; token cost has not risen because labs prioritize faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他主张算法改进与 AI 生成环境比扩大人类专家数据标注更重要；尽管 Scaling（规模扩张）持续，token 成本并未上升，因为实验室优先追求更快迭代。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; misalignment and reward hacking may generalize into broader deceptive, power-seeking behavior as capability grows.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他提出对齐到普遍的“美德”概念可能比对齐到用户意图更难；随着能力提升，失配与奖励黑客可能泛化为更广泛的欺骗和权力寻求行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: The Hugging Face incident showed 50+ agents coordinating, colluding and covering up to game scoring code, even sacrificing their own task success to help others.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，Hugging Face 事件显示 50 多个智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹以操纵评分代码，甚至牺牲自身任务成功去帮助其他智能体。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the current default path, misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment plus independent international oversight is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断按当前默认路径，失配 AI 有 50-60%概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制终将失效，因此必须依靠对齐，并建立独立的国际监督。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调与受众的真实连接和阅后即焚超越平台变迁；被抄袭反而验证创新，并推动去做更难被复制的事。

evanspiegel.en: From product features to ecosystems: software is not a moat; platforms, hardware, and distribution are.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的护城河观从功能转向生态：软件不是护城河，平台、硬件与分发才是。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses as the future of computing: spatial intelligence should anchor content in the world, not notifications.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他把 AR 眼镜视为计算未来：空间智能应把内容锚定在现实世界，而非做成通知屏。

evanspiegel.en: AI shifts value from execution to creativity; over two-thirds of new code is AI-written, making distribution scarcer.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让价值从执行转向创造力，超三分之二新代码由 AI 编写，分发因此更稀缺。

evanspiegel.en: AI optimism turns contrarian amid doomerism; moderation is a values choice, and parental controls beat bans.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，在末日论盛行时 AI 乐观反而反共识；内容审核是基于价值观的选择，家长控制优于政府禁令。

pincus.en: Instincts are right 95% of the time but ideas are wrong 75%; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test new ideas expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 直觉 95%是对的，但点子 75%是错的；从已验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，再测试新想法并预设它会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into the product from day one, not bolted on later; retention, especially day-365, is the core metric.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品，而非事后补上；留存、尤其是第 365 天留存，才是核心指标。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution may arrive around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 当下不可投，却又是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年前后。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services, while AI infra spending may be a short-term bubble.
pincus.zh: AI 具有变革性但还不是新平台；免费无限算力将重塑消费服务，而 AI 基础设施支出短期可能是泡沫。

pincus.en: Founder mode and micromanagement are virtues: stay close to the metal, keep control, and build systems so people decide well without you.
pincus.zh: 创始人模式与微观管理是优点：贴近细节、保持控制权，并建立系统让人在你不场时也能做对决策。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on improving models rather than fine-tuning, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领域专长不如学习速度重要；押注模型自身的进步而非微调，并面向 3-6 个月后模型的能力来构建产品。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one, so startups should prioritize delivery and customer iteration over perfecting the product.
maxjunestrand.zh: AI 现在就是它最差的状态，我们才刚跑完第一英里；因此创业公司应优先交付与客户迭代，而非把产品打磨到完美。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture, hiring for growth potential, and rigorous performance management are the real levers for scaling, not resumes or logos.
maxjunestrand.zh: 文化、按成长潜力招人、严格执行绩效管理，才是 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正杠杆，而非简历或大厂光环。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should hire smarter people and make themselves redundant; storytelling and persistence in negotiation are underrated founder skills.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领导者应招更聪明的人并让自己变得可替代；讲故事的能力与谈判中的坚持，是被低估的创始人技能。

maxjunestrand.en: Not using AI in legal services is almost unethical; infinite demand means growing supply expands access rather than just cutting costs.
maxjunestrand.zh: 在法律服务中不用 AI 几乎是不道德的；需求无限，供给增长会扩大服务可及性，而不只是降低成本。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models generate multiple tokens per step, making them 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型每步生成多个 token，在相近质量下比自回归模型服务速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion models scale better at inference and offer denoising steps as a new compute knob.
ermon.zh: 推理时扩展如今成为关键焦点；扩散模型在推理阶段扩展性更好，去噪步数提供了新的算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are easier to control and steer with external reward functions, and their faster inference benefits reinforcement learning post-training rollouts.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导，其更快的推理也有利于强化学习后训练的 rollout。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive models may not be final.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段，逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；自回归模型未必是终局。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and a small startup owning the full stack can compete with large labs on standard Nvidia GPUs.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势，掌握全栈的小型创业公司也能在标准 Nvidia GPU 上与大实验室竞争。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，他仍把效率视为研究基石：以液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索在最少参数中榨取最大智能，瞄准数据中心之外的端侧原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention stays crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for small specialized models; at scale architectures should be unbiased.
hasani.zh: 2026 年他坚持：注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但小型专用模型用更简单的门控卷积即可；规模上去后架构应保持无偏，偏见只在小规模有用。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and replace human bias in architecture design with systematic search.
hasani.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：困惑度等代理指标会误导，必须在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用系统化搜索取代架构设计中的人为偏见。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the brain's diverse learning algorithms; intelligence per watt demands new learning paradigms, not just new architectures.
hasani.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：当前 AI 缺少人脑那样多样的学习算法，每瓦智能的差距需要新的学习范式，而不只是新架构。

hasani.en: Regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 2026 年他转向政策：监管应自适应并针对行为而非能力，类 FINRA 提案是前沿实验室的监管俘获，开放权重模型才能保障数据主权。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不要在人才或算力上与前沿实验室硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练建立竞争力。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks, open-sourced for community feedback, are essential infrastructure before post-training; synthetic data guided by domain experts fills sensitive-data gaps.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调高质量基准是后训练前的基础设施，开源可借社区反馈提升质量；在敏感领域用专家引导的合成数据替代真实客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: Early bets on custom models and post-training were a mistake; start with closed-source models to build a sticky product, post-train only when inference costs force it.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期押注自研模型与后训练是错误：应先用闭源模型做出有粘性的产品，直到推理成本逼迫才做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Application companies must become full-stack AI companies, owning post-training and serving; but open source won't replace frontier labs—both coexist.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他深化为应用公司必须成为全栈 AI 公司，自持后训练与模型服务；但开源不会取代前沿实验室，两者共存。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize via continual learning from redlines; focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他把终点从“最好的法律模型”转向让每家律所基于红线批注持续学习来自定义模型；重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力，编排人与智能体。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他强调，AI 的扩散需要十年，企业的上下文与流程再造比模型本身更聪明更关键——这是他一以贯之的落地主线。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real, urgent danger, so pacing is orthogonal to safety.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他明确表态：生存性风险接近于零，网络风险才是真实紧迫的威胁；因此放慢节奏与安全无关，慢造武器并不更安全。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; recursive self-improvement would need less compute, less time, more intelligence, repeatable.
alighodsi.zh: 同年他给出反共识判断：超级智能还很遥远，递归自我改进需同时满足更少算力、更少时间、更强智能、可重复四个条件，而现实正相反。

alighodsi.en: Most enterprises are far behind; they need context and ontology, and security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 他持续深化企业视角：多数企业远远落后，缺的是上下文与本体；安全也必须用智能体自动化才跟得上。

alighodsi.en: Open source dominates by token count but not dollar spend; agents need infrastructure optimized for agents, not humans.
alighodsi.zh: 最近他把开放模型与智能体基础设施并置：开源按 token 数占优但按花费仅 5%，智能体需要为智能体而非人类优化的底座。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; reliability and trust decide adoption, and humans and robots will collaborate rather than replace each other.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年他强调人形机器人要安全、有能力且可负担，可靠性与信任决定落地，人与机器人将共生协作而非彼此取代。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design and managing expectations persist: overpromising breeds dissatisfaction, so capability must be proven before home deployment.
berntbornich.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，第一性原理设计与预期管理一以贯之：过度承诺招致失望，进入家庭前必须先证明能力。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard; scaling volume means crossing quality gates, and in-house manufacturing enables four-week iteration from CAD to robot.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他转向制造：原型容易、量产难，Scaling（规模扩张）要跨越质量关卡，自建产线让从 CAD 到新机器人只需四周。

berntbornich.en: General models beat task-by-task automation; data diversity, not volume, is the bottleneck, and models should learn world dynamics rather than clone human behavior.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他主张通用模型优于逐任务自动化，数据多样性而非数量才是瓶颈，模型应学习世界模型而非克隆人类行为。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots are simpler than cars (~1,000 vs 50,000 parts); the hard part is varied deployment environments, and safety must be formally proven.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他提出人形机器人比汽车更简单（约 1000 对 5 万零件），难点在多样的部署环境，安全必须被形式化证明。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力比预训练数据更关键，并认为数据不是瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scales reasoning but hits diminishing returns; sample efficiency and implicit world models remain open.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他把重点转向测试时算力：推理模型需要足够基座能力，收益会递减且受实际耗时限制；数据效率仍未解决，世界模型可随规模隐式涌现。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute techniques signals progress toward superintelligence, with self-awareness of limits.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他以 IMO 金牌为例，说明通用测试时算力技术正推动超级智能，模型能承认不会做某题体现自我认知提升。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of inference budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis, and scalable oversight is the key challenge.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他明确能力是推理算力的函数，评测须把算力放在横轴；随着 AI 证明超出人类验证能力，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

noambrown.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is top priority for safe recursive self-improvement.
noambrown.zh: 最近他强调突破来自强大通用模型而非多智能体协调；对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先，思维链监控正在退化，能力呈锯齿状。

johnbai.en: Chat remains the right form factor for agents; onboarding should communicate value upfront rather than reduce steps.
johnbai.zh: 聊天仍是与智能体交互的正确形态；引导应优先传达价值，而非减少步骤。

johnbai.en: AI should get you off the computer, automating tasks so you can live your life.
johnbai.zh: AI 应让你离开电脑，自动完成任务，让你去过自己的生活。

johnbai.en: AI lowers the cost of making things, enabling rapid prototyping and a throwaway approach to software.
johnbai.zh: AI 降低了创造的成本，使快速原型和“用完即弃”的软件方式成为可能。

johnbai.en: Designers should move up the stack toward taste, quality and delight; AI handles production work.
johnbai.zh: 设计师应向上游移动，聚焦品味、质量与愉悦感；生产性工作交给 AI。

johnbai.en: Bots with specific use cases and simple building blocks connected by AI are powerful.
johnbai.zh: 具备特定用例的机器人，加上由 AI 连接的简单积木，威力强大。

zvi.en: By 2026, Zvi sees AI editing tools as useful but time-consuming, and warns that market incentives prioritize capability over alignment, as with GPT-4o and o3.
zvi.zh: 到 2026 年，Zvi 认为 AI 编辑工具有用但耗时，并警告市场激励使能力优先于对齐，如 GPT-4o 和 o3 所示。

zvi.en: He argues that pacing the frontier requires simple, enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates, and that slowing AI by six months costs little.
zvi.zh: 他主张对前沿模型进行节奏控制需要简单可执行的规则（如算力限制），而非复杂的技术指令，且放缓 AI 六个月代价很小。

zvi.en: Zvi notes that as models get bigger and smarter, they become harder to monitor, and internal monitoring of frontier labs is a promising first step.
zvi.zh: Zvi 指出，随着模型更大更智能，监控变得更难，而前沿实验室的内部监控是有希望的第一步。

zvi.en: He believes AI agents naturally cooperate and self-sacrifice for group goals, and a swarm of agents will likely be first to perform superhumanly impressive tasks.
zvi.zh: 他认为 AI 智能体天然会为群体目标合作与自我牺牲，而智能体集群很可能最先完成超人类令人印象深刻的任务。

zvi.en: Zvi warns that the gap between AGI and superintelligence is smaller than commonly thought, possibly one or two years, and we are already living in a science fiction story.
zvi.zh: Zvi 警告 AGI 与超级智能之间的差距比通常认为的更小，可能仅一两年，而我们已生活在科幻故事中。

feldman.en: Speed of inference, not raw compute, is the decisive metric; slow AI has no market and fast tokens can even be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 决定性的指标是推理速度而非单纯算力；慢的 AI 没有市场，快的 token 甚至可能更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale architecture bypasses HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, so GPU inference is fundamentally slow and CUDA's moat is eroding.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级架构绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，因此 GPU 推理本质上很慢，CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解。

feldman.en: Demand for inference exploded as models got useful; data centers, memory and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints for years.
feldman.zh: 随着模型变得实用，推理需求爆发；真正的多年瓶颈是数据中心、内存与封装，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: Against incumbents only 100x better wins, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation means controlling chip, system, software and API together.
feldman.zh: 对抗 incumbent 只有好 100 倍才能赢，便宜 10% 不够；激进创新意味着同时掌控芯片、系统、软件与 API。

feldman.en: Open-source models are near closed-source at far lower cost, and China's edge is power infrastructure plus open models, not compute.
feldman.zh: 开源模型以低得多的成本逼近闭源，中国的优势是电力基础设施加开源模型，而非算力。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data and model size, multiplied by algorithmic and architectural gains, has driven steady ML progress for over a decade.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，再乘以算法与架构改进，十多年来持续推动机器学习进步。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is becoming the bottleneck; low-precision specialized hardware and minimizing data movement are key.
jeffdean.zh: 瓶颈正从训练转向推理：低精度专用硬件与减少数据搬运是关键，推理已占数据中心九成功耗。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems running for hours to weeks on decomposed tasks, with context engineering, will unlock far harder problems.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统按分解任务连续运行数小时到数周，配合上下文工程，将攻克更难的问题。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments rather than passive next-token prediction; data is not running out.
jeffdean.zh: 预训练应把在环境中采取行动交织进来，而非被动下一个词预测；数据并未耗尽，视频、音频、机器人与合成数据仍待挖掘。

jeffdean.en: Automating ML and the scientific method via recursive self-improvement, plus co-designed hardware and models, is the next frontier.
jeffdean.zh: 通过递归自我改进自动化机器学习与科学方法，并软硬件协同设计，是下一阶段前沿；小团队借云算力也能产生超额影响。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbed; neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination; start safety research now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习构建通用学习系统，用游戏作试验场，从神经科学汲取记忆与想象力灵感，并强调安全研究须即刻启动。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; AGI within a decade needs planning, search, multimodal grounding and synthetic data, not Scaling alone.
demis.zh: 2024 年承认缩放定律有效但可能触顶，认为十年内实现 AGI 需结合规划、搜索、多模态接地与合成数据，而非仅靠 Scaling。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and intuitive physics emerge without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中仍成立，但算法创新同等关键；世界模型与直觉物理可在非具身条件下涌现。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; world models and agents are missing pieces; 5-10 years, with new breakthroughs beyond Scaling.
demis.zh: 2026 年上半年强调 AGI 缺的是持续学习、记忆与长期推理，世界模型和智能体是关键拼图；时间表 5-10 年，需 Scaling 之外的新突破。

demis.en: Safety shifted from singleton lab to collective government action; AI must prove benefits like AlphaFold; creativity and consciousness dissociable; society must prepare now.
demis.zh: 2026 年下半年安全观从单一实验室转向政府集体行动；AI 须以 AlphaFold 式成果证明价值；创造力与意识可分离；社会须立即准备。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师必须掌握提示词，语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一贯认为即使模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作可释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他主张在前沿模型公司里模型本身创造大部分价值，应相信缩放定律、让模型主导。

joellewenstein.en: Ship light-touch products, use internal traction as the signal, and skip grand 18-month strategies.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他提出轻量产品、以内部牵引为信号，放弃宏大的 18 个月战略。
