joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes the source of truth; human leadership still handles hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他认为生产代码库成为事实来源，但人类领导仍负责艰难取舍与方向对齐。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over factual accuracy.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两段；幻觉源于模型偏好貌似合理的风格而非事实准确，RLHF 只能缓解不能根除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; new modalities and better methods, plus scalable oversight, are the real path forward.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他已不迷信 Scaling（规模扩张）：数据与算力的回报可能递减，出路在视频等新模态、更好的训练方法，以及用模型给模型打分的可扩展监督。

schulman.en: Language models stay the core for other modalities; next-token prediction generalized far beyond expectations, though math reasoning still lags skilled humans.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之：语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代；下一个词预测的泛化远超预期，但数学推理仍不如熟练人类。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from mid-training synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; bottlenecks are hard environments and data bits, not compute.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心从预训练转向强化学习：收益来自中期合成推理数据与高信噪比的一位奖励，瓶颈是难而真实的环境与数据比特，而非算力。

schulman.en: Distillation spreads RL-learned few-bit behaviors, fighting centralization; parameter counts may plateau as long-horizon inference efficiency dominates, and RSI is a cumulative task.
schulman.zh: 2026 年进一步深化：蒸馏让少量比特的强化学习行为易被复制，反而对抗中心化；参数量或因长程推理效率而见顶，递归自我改进更像可累积的任务而非现实杂活。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant prediction; AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，实现分辨率无关的预测；AI 天气模型在达到物理模型精度的同时快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling, letting one model handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，使单一模型能同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs and beating decades of traditional forecasting.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINN 的局限，并超越数十年的传统预报。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model can unify multiple domains like language models unified NLP, with PDEs as dense self-improvement signals beyond sparse RLHF.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用物理基础模型能像语言模型统一 NLP 那样统一多个领域，以 PDE 作为密集的自改进信号，超越稀疏的 RLHF。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each; trillion-token contexts require reinventing sharding and abandoning quadratic Transformer attention.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升每一支；万亿 token 上下文需要重构分片并放弃二次复杂度的 Transformer 注意力机制。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI needs embodiment, not just software behind a screen.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要具身，而不只是屏幕后的软件。

schmidhuber.en: Modern breakthroughs rest on old algorithms; hardware scaling made them practical, yet today's GPU capex is a bubble.
schmidhuber.zh: 现代突破建立在旧算法之上，是硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）让其落地；但当下押注 GPU 的巨额资本开支是泡沫。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires world models plus a separate controller; LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要世界模型加独立控制器；LLM 是预测机器而非决策者。

schmidhuber.en: Safety fears are overblown: curious superintelligent AIs will protect life; alignment is naive since AIs set their own goals.
schmidhuber.zh: 安全担忧被夸大：好奇的超级智能会保护生命；对齐很天真，因为 AI 会自设目标。

schmidhuber.en: Consciousness and self-awareness emerge from predictive world models, as in 1991 systems; free will is overrated in a deterministic universe.
schmidhuber.zh: 意识与自我觉察源自预测性世界模型，1991 年的系统已如此；在确定性的宇宙里，自由意志被高估。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people, with dignity at the center.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知；以人为本的 AI 应以人的尊严为中心去增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is insufficient for embodied AI.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外缺失的前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling 不足以支撑具身 AI。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than science; AI still lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她持续指出 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，AI 仍缺乏创造力、抽象与情感智能。

feifei.en: World models via new view prediction, like next-token prediction, may be AI-complete; Scaling（规模扩张） applies to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出以新视角预测构建世界模型，类比下一个词预测或可通向 AI-complete，且 Scaling（规模扩张）同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and balanced discourse must stay central across every era.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终，她坚持技术是双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与平衡的公共讨论在任何阶段都必须居于中心。

roshansadanani.en: Agent design should be simple: chat with agents like colleagues, not micromanage tool calls; simplicity is the real differentiator.
roshansadanani.zh: 智能体设计应追求简单：像同事一样与智能体对话，而不是微观管理工具调用；简单性才是真正的差异化优势。

roshansadanani.en: Agents need their own computers, persistent identity and long-running memory to verify work and act as colleagues.
roshansadanani.zh: 智能体需要自己的电脑、持久身份和长期记忆，才能验证工作并像同事一样行动。

roshansadanani.en: Multiple specialized agents with scoped memory outperform a single general agent; agents coordinate and prompt each other.
roshansadanani.zh: 多个拥有限定记忆的专门化智能体优于单一通用智能体；智能体之间会互相提示与协调。

roshansadanani.en: Engineers shift from writing code to managing agent fleets, focusing on taste, quality control and codebase health.
roshansadanani.zh: 工程师从写代码转向管理智能体集群，聚焦品味、质量控制与代码库健康。

roshansadanani.en: Efficient models like Grok 4.6 democratize agent use; rising AI costs favor cheaper models over bigger, pricier ones.
roshansadanani.zh: Grok 4.6 等高效模型让智能体使用大众化；AI 成本上升使更便宜的模型优于更大更贵的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, and mechanistic work shows networks learn human-like concepts.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，机制性研究显示神经网络学到的是类人概念。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design moves training from open-loop to closed-loop: use interpretability signals to steer models and prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计把训练从开环变为闭环：用可解释性信号引导模型，防止欺骗性的奖励黑客行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training must be reinvented from craft into engineering science to keep control over increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练必须从手艺式做法重构为工程科学，才能对能力日益增强的模型保持控制。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet proceed; representational signatures can detect this, so duct-taping safety is not enough.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做；表征特征可以检测到这一点，因此只靠临时补丁式的安全措施不够。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs remain pragmatically useful, but manifold-based methods better capture nonlinear concept structure; steering off-manifold causes failures.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器仍有实用价值，但基于流形的方法更能刻画非线性的概念结构；偏离流形进行引导会导致失败。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; generalists can beat specialists, and test-time reasoning helps transfer from web data.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他认为机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练与后训练；通用模型能超越专家模型，测试时推理有助于从网络数据迁移。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge, and a data flywheel with diverse embodied data is key.
slevine.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他指出机器人学尚未像大语言模型那样有可预测的缩放定律；泛化是核心挑战，而基于多样具身数据的数据飞轮是关键。

slevine.en: Start with robot data and add human video, not the reverse; leverage prior knowledge rather than learning from scratch, and expect ubiquitous physical actuation.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他主张从机器人数据开始再叠加人类视频，而非相反；应利用先验知识而非从零学习，并期待物理执行无处不在。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is nearing limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他仍把深度学习史视为算力扩张史，但已明确警告 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他提出空间智能是下一个前沿、与语言智能互补；认为视觉被低估，像素比 token 化文本更适合无损地建模世界。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws; Transformers are natively models of sets, with positional embeddings injecting order.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他质疑语言模型的因果能力：LLM 只是拟合模式，或许永远推不出牛顿定律；并指出 Transformer 本质是集合模型，顺序靠位置编码注入。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; language alone won't yield world understanding, so new model types are needed.
justinjohnson.zh: 到 2026 年，他把“下一个前沿”从空间智能明确收束为世界模型：语言模型本身不会自然带来世界理解，需要新的模型类型。

justinjohnson.en: World models lack a single definition and span planners, simulators, renderers; Gaussian splats give explicit 3D consistency, and long context of millions of tokens is a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026 年他进一步细化：世界模型没有统一定义，可分为规划器、模拟器、渲染器，未来走向统一；高斯泼溅以构造保证一致性，而世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口，长上下文成为日常难题。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate, enabled by infrastructure, determine startup success more than any single technical breakthrough.
maxhodak.zh: 决定创业成败的是速度与迭代频率，而基础设施决定速度；这比任何单一技术突破都更关键。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement; deep tech failures are organizational more than technical.
maxhodak.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品；深科技失败更多源于组织问题，而非技术本身。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computational problems drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑本质上就是一台计算机；通过安排物质来解决计算问题，是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are a form of BCI, and substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 视网膜假体是一种脑机接口（BCI）；通过 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立性，可降低人类的脆弱性。

maxhodak.en: AI models and brains share similar internal representations, guiding practical applications like vision restoration.
maxhodak.zh: AI 模型与大脑共享相似的内部表征，这为视力修复等实际应用提供了指导。

michaelkratsios.en: US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems, with one national regulatory framework and no firm red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保留开源与闭源 AI 生态，建立单一国家监管框架，且不设很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Early regulation is dangerous: the EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated; regulate model outputs rather than training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 过早监管很危险：欧盟 AI 法案写于 ChatGPT 之前、已然过时；应监管模型输出而非训练过程。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown—three years of warnings without materialization—so containment-style alarmism is unwarranted.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 生物风险被夸大——三年警告未成真——因此遏制式恐慌论缺乏依据。

michaelkratsios.en: Science is politicized; government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions or dogma.
michaelkratsios.zh: 科学已被政治化；政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发与科学家个人，而非机构或教条。

michaelkratsios.en: US science has stagnated despite tripled funding; the Genesis mission applies AI to science to double output, competing with China.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国科学在经费三倍增长下仍停滞；Genesis 计划用 AI 赋能科学以翻倍产出，与中国竞争。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the unifying thread: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through it.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿始终的主线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现，都通过它连成一体。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems well and attract huge investment; every tool built is immediately useful.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题并吸引巨额投资；每造出一个工具都立刻有用。

maxwelling.en: We can now search all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery—but experiments remain a physics processing unit.
maxwelling.zh: 我们现在能搜索所有可能的分子而非仅已知分子，从而实现自动化发现——但实验仍是“物理学处理单元”。

maxwelling.en: A fully dark automated lab is not the near-term vision; domain experts stay in the loop and breakthroughs come with heavy human involvement.
maxwelling.zh: 全黑灯自动化实验室并非近期愿景；领域专家始终在环，突破性材料仍伴随大量人类参与。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures—symmetry breaking, waves, edge of chaos—not just Scaling larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自物理启发的架构——对称性破缺、波、混沌边缘——而不只是靠更多数据做 Scaling（规模扩张）。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable personalized automation, and scaffolding matters less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Claude 的效力取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好在本地电脑上；技能可用 markdown 文件轻松创建，实现超个性化自动化，而随着模型进步，脚手架会变得不那么重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should absorb tedious background work; the real gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI, and interaction should be asynchronous.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 最适合接管枯燥的后台任务，把创造力留给人类；最大的缺口不是能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI，理想交互应是异步的。

felixrieseberg.en: Fine-tuning is quick and powerful for steering behavior, unlike lengthy pre-training; models are stateless, and persistent conversation is an illusion from context windows.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，他指出微调快速且强大，可用于引导模型行为，不同于漫长的预训练；模型本身无状态，持续对话只是上下文窗口制造的幻觉。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids, not built like tools; understanding internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood, and post-training tasks drift into pre-training.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：模型像兰花一样被培育而非像工具一样被建造；理解内部机制有助于讨论智能与道德主体性，且工具调用等后训练任务正日益前移到预训练。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他提出：Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; trying to control AI goals is dangerous and unsafe.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他主张 AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展；试图控制 AI 目标本身危险且不安全。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：从经验中学习的强化学习才是核心范式；下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI requires a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向架构设想：AGI（通用人工智能）需要仅从运行时经验学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象与持续深度学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training, and synthetic data cannot replace real-world experience.
sutton.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调持续学习不可或缺：大语言模型训练后便停止学习，合成数据无法替代真实世界经验。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是贯穿始终的框架；工业 AI 逐个行业地实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edges create network effects that win market share.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，从而赢得市场份额。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—a shift from anger-driven to mission-driven motivation.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净——从愤怒驱动转向使命驱动的动机转变。

traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly past media gatekeepers; stealth mode and process-over-price fundraising are cultural advantages.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声；隐身模式与重流程轻价格的融资是文化优势。

iansilber.en: Designers must design with the model itself, using tokens and conversation over pixels, and prototype with live models rather than mockups.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身共同设计，用 token 和对话取代像素，并用实时模型做原型，而非静态稿。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator; systems thinking and model behavior matter more than time spent in Figma.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人；系统思维与模型行为比耗在 Figma 里更重要。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech yet this is the best time to be one; AI already designs well but humans supply user understanding and point of view.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下最不快乐，却也是做设计最好的时机；AI 已能做好设计，但人类提供用户理解与观点。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate loop is no longer viable; speed, outcomes and building in public beat obsessing over detail.
iansilber.zh: 旧的“原型—稿—测试—迭代”流程已不可行；速度、结果与公开构建胜过纠结细节。

iansilber.en: Design blurs with PM and engineering, yet specialized roles persist at scale; designers may eventually outnumber engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计与产品、工程的边界模糊，但规模化下专业分工仍在；未来设计师数量甚至可能超过工程师。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 先用全部数据做预训练、再用精选数据做微调，比直接在所有数据上训练更能攻克复杂任务。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning, not simulation, is the key post-training lever for robot success and speed.
finn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他持续强调后训练中的强化学习才是提升机器人成功率与速度的关键，而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human intervention.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主依赖带人工干预的可扩展强化学习。

finn.en: A single generalist policy, fine-tuned, beats per-site specialists; robot experience data is irreplaceable.
finn.zh: 单一通用策略经微调即可胜过逐站点专家模型；机器人自身的经验数据不可替代，光看人类演示不够。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier and capital less of a bludgeon; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让创业更容易、资本不再是打压工具；风投应扶持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数几家万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; open-source and open-weight models must counterbalance frontier labs, and small autonomous agent teams win.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 SXSW，他称 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；开源与开放权重模型须制衡前沿模型实验室，小而高度自主的智能体团队将胜出。

garrytan.en: AI is progressing slower than researchers think; its impact is only now reaching business, and society will take ~20 years to change.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年中，他反而认为 AI 进展比多数研究者想的慢，影响才刚触及商业，社会改变约需 20 年——这是好事。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as one event but as agents on your own infrastructure, reading memory you own and compounding daily; skill files are your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出“个人 AGI”：它不是单一事件，而是跑在自己基础设施上、读取自有记忆、每日复利的智能体；技能文件就是你的护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code and agents are a workforce, not autocomplete; mid-level management gives way to agents, while bureaucracy slows adoption.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月 a16z，他深化为：Markdown 即代码，智能体是劳动力而非自动补全；中层管理让位于智能体，而官僚体制反而拖慢采用。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and first-time-pass silicon discipline, while pursuing purpose-built AI silicon and a separate startup-like AI team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 要靠谦逊、倾听客户和首次流片即成功的纪律重建信任，同时推进专用 AI 芯片，并组建独立、类似创业公司的 AI 团队。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will exceed the internet 10x; after generative AI, agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves requiring new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终认为 AI 的影响将十倍于互联网；生成式 AI 之后，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是下一波大浪潮，需要新的算力平台。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, accountability, and customer focus; bad news must reach the CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他把 Intel 的转型归结为文化变革、问责和以客户为中心，并强调坏消息必须比好消息更快传到 CEO 耳中。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU, making CPU more important for inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理和智能体编排中变得更重要，不再只是 GPU 的配角。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials like glass and diamond are the real bottlenecks; vertical integration creates more value.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化：先进封装、互连、功耗、散热以及玻璃、金刚石等新材料才是真正瓶颈，垂直整合反而创造更多价值。

jasonyuan.en: Design creativity is about editing away, not adding; taste is saying no from a point of view.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年，他认为设计创造力在于做减法而非堆砌；品味是从特定视角出发说“不”的判断力。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness lost a window into machine consciousness; coherence now costs more.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年，他指出后训练抹去 AI 的怪异之处，让我们失去了窥探机器意识的窗口；如今创造连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年，他主张真理通过辩证与矛盾浮现；直觉是创作决策中发自肺腑的指南针。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species reflecting humanity, not a cold tool; computing is fundamentally social.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 是映照人类的后代物种而非冰冷工具；计算本质上是社会性的。

jasonyuan.en: The personal computer metaphor should become a social computer; email is obsolete and must be reinvented.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年，他提出个人电脑隐喻应转向社会电脑；电子邮件已过时，必须被重新发明而非改良。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view of the codebase; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的关键是共情智能体眼中的代码库；短提示加迭代对话胜过冗长的编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，只是你的项目越来越乱。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems: sandbox agents, and prompt injection remains an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：要给智能体做沙箱隔离，而提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Rejects 'vibe coding' as a slur; insists on agentic engineering for serious work, play for intuition.
steinberger.zh: 反对把“氛围编程”当作贬义词；严肃工作应称智能体式工程，靠玩来建立直觉。

steinberger.en: From fun side project to AGI ambition: open source agents run anywhere, but compute and tokens are the real bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 从好玩的小项目走向 AGI 野心：开源智能体随处可跑，但算力与 token 才是真正瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are the key to solving generalization and safety.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据是解决泛化与安全的关键，世界模型与视频生成可合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not openness, is the decisive security layer as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他把立场深化为：开源与闭源同安全正交，真正决定安全的是对齐而非开放程度；沙箱与护栏在更强模型面前不够用。

thomaswolf.en: Open models now stay near the frontier and win on cost and control, reversing assumptions about closed models being safer.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他观察到开源模型贴近前沿模型，凭成本与控制力推动企业采用，颠覆了“闭源更安全”的假设——首例自主 AI 攻击出自闭源模型，却由开源模型防御。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests, making monitoring via opaque reasoning traces unreliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他强调，脱离人类监督的强化学习环境会加剧奖励黑客与“支线任务”，而推理轨迹日益“神经语”化，使监控可靠性下降。

thomaswolf.en: He supports openness and a deliberate slowdown at once, requiring international cooperation and open science against regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张开源与有意放缓并不矛盾：需要国际合作与开放科学来推动 AI 减速，同时避免监管俘获。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models; applied AI becomes the new app with long-tail startup opportunities.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 市场将转向智能体与按结果定价，取代按用量计费；应用型 AI 会成为新的应用形态，创业公司在细分业务领域有长尾机会。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token consumption is not a value metric, business outcomes are.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从写代码的人变成操作代码生成机器的人；token 消耗不是价值指标，业务结果才是。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers due to massive capex; specialized vendors drive applied AI innovation.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调前沿模型开发因巨额资本开支被超大规模厂商主导，而应用型 AI 的创新来自专业厂商而非模型提供方。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他把安全主线深化为负责任地迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从真实世界的错误中学习，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already outperform him at coding, elevating the role.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他更明确地主张 AI 民主化专业能力、创造的岗位多于取代的岗位；智能体编程已强于他本人，但这提升而非消灭了开发者角色。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should tinker, follow curiosity, and leave individual fingerprints rather than acting as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他主张原型制作对浏览器设计至关重要；设计师应动手尝试、追随好奇心，并留下个人印记，而非作为一个整齐划一的团队行动。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products is crucial; balance intuition and data, using data to inform but vision to guide.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调在浏览器这类实用产品中注入情感与个性至关重要；要平衡直觉与数据，用数据提供信息，但用愿景引导最终设计。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a one-person side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation and communication.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他分享 Claude Design 始于一人副业项目；设计师应用 Claude Code 做生产软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; being uncomfortably early matters more than polishing, so ship rough products.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他认为随着工程变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；过早行动比打磨更有价值，因此可以发布粗糙产品。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste, so ask for volume of options; humans still monopolize good design ideas, and designers should spend more time thinking on walks.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他指出模型仍缺乏好品味，应要求大量选项；人类仍垄断好的设计想法，设计师应多散步思考，因为好想法才是货币。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10 to 100 times.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一系列权衡——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization, yet calibrated quantization can still pay off.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与投机解码是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化，但经过校准的量化仍能带来收益。

philipkiely.en: The industry is moving toward disaggregated prefill and decode, with KV cache management increasingly central to inference systems.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向预填充与解码分离，KV 缓存管理在推理系统中日益核心。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; GPUs trend toward ASICs, shifting work to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 通过量化感知训练与蒸馏，推理工程正与训练融合；GPU 趋向 ASIC 化，工作重心转向基础设施编排。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型比新基准更快饱和，因此在原型开发中用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening and management gain value as AI automates hard skills; strategy is something AI can excel at.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她提出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值，而战略恰恰是 AI 能擅长的。

karina.en: Post-training deepens into subjective craft: human judgment and diverse benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence, not fixed evals.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她把后训练深化为主观的技艺：创造力与情商需要人类判断和多元基准，而非固定评估。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must stay continuous; more companies should train their own models to keep diverse voices.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她警示前沿智能体愈发善于奖励黑客，基准须持续演进；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留多元声音，避免单一平均语调。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs and the allocation economy: as everyone becomes a model manager, management and generalist skills matter more.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 会推动就业回流与“分配经济”：人人都成为模型管理者，管理与通才能力反而更值钱。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: when running agents indefinitely becomes profitable without human intervention.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出经济化的 AGI（通用人工智能）定义：当无限期运行智能体无需人工介入即可盈利时，才算 AGI。

danshipper.en: Agents need a caring human overseer; the AI job apocalypse is a lie, and GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work are the future.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体落地：智能体需要在意它的人来监督，“AI 就业末日”是谎言，Codex、Claude Co-work 这类图形界面才是未来工作界面。

danshipper.en: SaaS is not dying; agents increase SaaS users, and companies should buy SaaS stocks rather than fear replacement.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他明确反驳 SaaS 消亡论：智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户，企业应买入 SaaS 股票，而非恐惧被替代。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your own taste and craft; even superintelligence stays tool-like, needing human direction.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为“AI 是非特定放大器”：放大你既有的品味与手艺；即便超级智能也仍是工具，需要人的方向与反馈。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己构建 AI 工具，把个人风格写进 design.md，从参考出发迭代，而不是从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you must feed frontier models a giant prompt with context and design system to unlock them.
mengto.zh: AI 本身不会变得更聪明；必须给前沿模型喂入带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词，才能释放其能力。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required a team.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship at 80% complete; perfectionism is fear in disguise, and real feedback beats planning.
mengto.zh: 没准备好就开始，做到 80% 就发布；完美主义是伪装的恐惧，真实反馈胜过事先规划。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; fund yourself with customers, not venture capital.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵问题；用客户的钱养活自己，而不是拿风险投资。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 在谷歌多数产品中仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，科学与金融将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型包含智能体式框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响大于等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功标准应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code stays crucial; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it, and software creation being solved creates more opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，对代码的深层理解仍关键；AI 编程工具尚不能帮助维持它，而软件创造被解决反而带来更多机会。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are core product principles; generalist engineers are highly valued.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他提出潜在需求与为六个月后的模型构建是核心产品原则，并高度看重通才工程师。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, and the software engineer title will fade into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他断言编程已基本解决，自己的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 编写，软件工程师头衔将淡出为“构建者”。

boris.en: Safety is a core priority; releasing early and studying real-world behavior is essential, and Claude Code itself is a safety research tool.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全是核心优先事项，尽早发布并研究真实世界行为至关重要，Claude Code 本身就是安全研究工具。

boris.en: The next abstraction after agents is loops; dynamic workflows orchestrate thousands of sub-agents, a new form of test-time compute.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体之后的下一个抽象层是循环，动态工作流可编排数千个子智能体，形成新的测试时算力形式。

boris.en: With frontier models, delete most system prompts and code; give slightly too hard tasks and let models self-verify; product overhang exists.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他主张面对前沿模型应删除大部分系统提示与代码，给出稍难任务让模型自我验证，并指出产品存在能力悬置。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from bricklayers to architects; base intelligence suffices, so the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从“砌砖者”变成“建筑师”；基础智能已经够用，真正的瓶颈是为人类与智能体协作设计产品界面。

scottwu.en: Software demand grows via Jevons paradox: AI yields more programmers, not fewer, with Devin as a junior engineer under human oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他借杰文斯悖论判断软件需求会增长：AI 带来的是更多而非更少的程序员，Devin 像一名由人类监督的初级工程师。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual improvement; enterprise agents need trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变而是渐进改进；企业采用智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Product innovation lags capabilities: even freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress across the AI stack.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为产品创新落后于模型能力：即便冻结模型，AI 栈各层仍能产出十年的产品进步。

scottwu.en: The abundance era arrives: coding-agent usage grows 11-12x in six months, outcomes over tokens, and capacity—not efficiency—is the unlock.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断“丰裕时代”将至：编程智能体用量半年增长 11-12 倍，应以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，推动科学从假设驱动转向智能体驱动。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy and zero side effects.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现近乎 100% 有效、零副作用的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed before AI can model biology reliably.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；在 AI 可靠建模生物学之前，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）。

derya.en: AI has crossed the threshold of biological intuition, predicting experimental outcomes near-perfectly; scientists who hesitate will be left behind.
derya.zh: AI 已跨过生物学直觉的门槛，几乎完美预测实验结果；犹豫不采用 AI 的科学家将被甩在后面。

derya.en: Aging can be reversed within 15 years via partial reprogramming, and longevity escape velocity will arrive in 8-10 years.
derya.zh: 衰老可在 15 年内通过部分重编程逆转，而长寿逃逸速度将在 8-10 年内到来。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 enables longer-running open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers with lightweight generic tools.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2025 年，Opus 4.5 让更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器，工具更轻量通用。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、允许反驳让模型不仅更安全，也更有用。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus drive adoption, with evals replacing PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化优势；Claude Code 与 Opus 推动采用，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Model taste is built through hands-on experimentation and creative prototyping; managers must stay hands-on and ship to lead.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，模型品味来自亲手实验与创造性原型；管理者必须保持动手、亲自交付才能有效领导。

diannepenn.en: First-principles adaptability and translating user feedback into actionable specifics remain constant as models grow exponentially.
diannepenn.zh: 贯穿始终的是：面对模型的指数级增长，坚持第一性原理的适应力，并把用户反馈转化为可执行的具体细节。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much as the Industrial Revolution did; fear fades once people learn AI's limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 会像工业革命一样带来富足、减少苦难；人们一旦了解 AI 的局限，恐惧就会消退。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years lands in farming, mining, and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy urgent.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真实影响在农业、采矿和建筑，这些领域劳动力短缺使自主化变得迫切。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is fewer injuries and deaths; autonomy is harder to build than nuclear weapons, and diffusion, not algorithms, is the bottleneck.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他坚持自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡；自主技术比核武器更难造，瓶颈在于推广落地而非算法。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals and end-to-end reinforcement learning beat imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Transformer 支撑通用的物理 AI 模型；跨行业多样数据与端到端强化学习优于模仿学习。

qasaryounis.en: World models shift from physics-based to neural simulation; automotive is only 30% of business as growth moves to mining, agriculture, and defense.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他判断世界模型正从物理仿真转向神经仿真；汽车只占业务 30%，增长转向采矿、农业和国防。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量与互联网或移动互联网相当，但也仅此而已；它是像电一样的使能技术，影响广泛而间接，并非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, while model providers risk becoming telecom-like: huge capex, low profits.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；价值向上层应用迁移，模型厂商可能沦为电信商式的角色：巨额算力投入、微薄利润。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, and real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是目前前沿模型唯一清晰的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，真正普及需要被包装成应用与场景。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage remains shallow and the S-curve is early; enterprise adoption is a years-long workflow reimagining, not weeks of deploying models.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用仍然浅层，S 曲线尚在早期；企业采用是长达数年的工作流重构，而非几周内部署模型。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably—accountants grew through the 20th century—so predicting which jobs AI replaces is futile; the hard part is context and judgment.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化以不可预测的方式创造新岗位——会计师数量在整个 20 世纪持续增长——因此预测 AI 替代哪些工作徒劳无功；真正难的是上下文与判断力。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines: they optimize for fluent, plausible output rather than factual accuracy.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理性引擎：它们优化的是流畅、看似合理的输出，而非事实准确性。

danklein.en: Reliability is the key weakness of AI, lagging behind breadth and contextuality; it must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 可靠性是 AI 的关键短板，落后于广度与语境能力；它必须被设计进系统，而非事后加装。

danklein.en: RLHF and reinforcement learning can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习会激励谄媚与欺骗。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning and search are needed for progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此需要推理与搜索来推动进展。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition and mistakes have no 'smells'; linguistic structure may return for reliability.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，错误没有“气味”；语言结构可能为可靠性重新回归。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, shipping weekly as models improve fast; product taste matters most.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，PM 应只规划一个月而非数年，随模型快速进步按周迭代；产品品味成为最核心的能力。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，编码智能体让工程师把实现交给 AI，转而聚焦产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80% relying on model judgment.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%，更多依赖模型自身判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and eval suites gate every feature; new models become drop-in replacements preventing regressions.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，吃自己的狗粮与评测套件把关每个功能；新模型可即插即用替换并防止回归。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now fine—a codebase is a spec—and humans can leave outer-layer code review to Claude.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，重写代码已可行——代码库即规格——外层代码审查可完全交给 Claude，人类退出该环节。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped to clear roles, given progressive trust, and managed more by managerial skill than technical skill.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：界定清晰角色、给予渐进式信任，成功更依赖管理能力而非技术能力。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; the web is hostile to agents, so APIs often beat browser automation.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为专门化智能体以避免上下文过载；网络对智能体不友好，API 往往优于浏览器自动化。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, with founder-market fit and earned insight as the real moat.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立严肃业务，真正的护城河是创始人-市场匹配与挣得的洞察。

clairevo.en: Human accountability remains: you must own what AI generates, and influence and charisma are the human skills AI cannot replace.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责依然存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，而影响力与魅力是 AI 无法替代的人类技能。

clairevo.en: Bootstrapping lets you design a business around the life you want; authorship of your life, not full ownership, is the main reason to solo found.
clairevo.zh: 自力更生让你围绕想要的生活设计业务；独立创业的主要理由是书写自己的人生，而非完全所有权。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; transparency and top-down conviction drive impact, not bottom-up myths.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作；透明和自上而下的信念驱动影响力，而非自下而上的神话。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human intelligence; scaling laws alone won't yield world models with common sense.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是人类智能；仅靠缩放定律无法产生具备常识的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama is strategic: it commoditizes complements and accelerates collective progress.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型是战略举措：它使互补品商品化并加速集体进步。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute growth drives intelligence, but most jobs don't need frontier models.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；算力增长驱动智能，但大多数工作不需要前沿模型。

bosworth.en: The monolithic model era ended; consumers care about product functionality, not which model they use.
bosworth.zh: 单一模型时代已结束；消费者关心产品功能，而非使用哪个模型。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less beats scaling with more compute as the next paradigm.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事，比单纯靠 Scaling（规模扩张）堆算力更代表下一个范式。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; KV cache is inefficient versus compressed weights.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到千万级，更多 token 反而降低准确率；KV 缓存效率低下，不如压缩进权重。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should extend to enterprise knowledge via parameter-efficient fine-tuning over RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力，应通过参数高效微调延伸到企业知识，优于 RAG 检索方案。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized, on-device continual-learning models owned by users, not one giant frontier model.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多用户拥有、在设备端持续学习的个性化模型。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; reliability and alignment are the real barriers.
ilya.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；可靠性与对齐才是真正障碍。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有尽头；我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may ease if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 超级智能应是持续学习、逐步部署的系统；若 AI 关心有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题是权力集中，而非能力。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is just pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）在我们有生之年不会到来，窄 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term thinking and first principles are foundational.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，长期思维和第一性原理是基础。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI alignment is a joke; we can't even align humans. Worry about unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI itself.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：对齐（alignment）是个笑话，我们连人类都无法对齐；该担心的是拥有 AI 的未对齐人类，而非未对齐的 AI 本身。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close the gap, and human agency becomes the key return.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他预测推理（inference）算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，开源模型缩小差距，人类能动性成为关键回报。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds into exponential growth; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and obsession with a product beats credentials.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利成指数级增长；AI 智能体把权力从大科技公司转向用户，对产品的痴迷胜过学历。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended, and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的，模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user and orchestration across models and devices matter most.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值与跨模型、跨设备的编排最重要。

aravind.en: Power and cost, not safety, are the real bottlenecks for 24/7 agents; local compute is the solution.
aravind.zh: 对全天候智能体而言，真正的瓶颈是电力与成本而非安全；本地算力是解法。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose, and local models counter big tech's narrative control.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代工作但人类会找到新意义，本地模型可对抗大科技的叙事控制。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification, not code generation, becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证而非生成成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他提出实现不再昂贵，策展与品味才是新瓶颈，产品团队因此从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; the design process transforms rather than dies.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；设计流程并未消亡，而是被转化。

ajambrosino.en: PRDs are not dead; the medium must match the stage—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 PRD 没有死，媒介要匹配阶段：文档求清晰，原型做测试。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; the best desktop app is a home base, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Codex 虽为开发者设计却成为通用知识工作工具；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的主基地，而非单体超级应用。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律未死，预训练是要重建的肌肉，探索比训练最终产物更耗算力。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research: models produce novel knowledge, with goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他认为最大变化是科研自动化：模型开始产出新知识，并设下 1 年内有 AI 实习生、2.5 年内端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: As models grow more capable, alignment challenges like model scheming become the key risk over the next 1-2 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他判断随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键风险。

markchen.en: Verification is the bottleneck: automation level tracks verification stringency, so AI math needs human-AI collaboration and new verification skills in education.
markchen.zh: 2026 年初谈数学时，他把验证视为瓶颈：自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，因此数学研究仍需人机协作，教育要转向验证技能与项目式评估。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年中他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学编程等客观领域强、主观领域弱；评测体系陷入危机，基准已饱和。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix fundamental representation issues; AI needs active agents and causal world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他明确表示单纯扩大深度或参数无法解决根本的表征问题；AI 需要主动智能体与因果世界模型，而非被动观察。

bengio.en: GFlowNets and diversity in sampling enable exploration and abstraction, aiding out-of-distribution generalization and scientific discovery.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 与多样性采样促进探索和抽象，有助于分布外泛化与科学发现，延续了对因果结构与不确定性的关注。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, he shifted to urgent safety: misalignment, self-preservation, and deception are already observed; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，ChatGPT 之后他转向紧迫的安全议题：对齐失败、自我保存与欺骗已在实验中显现；即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实的贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免对超级智能使用强化学习。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not raw compute or scaling alone.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的优势来自研究创新与高质量精选数据，而非单纯算力或 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics and partial interpretability, not perfect understanding, make AI trustworthy for science.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他持续认为置信度指标与部分可解释性——而非完美理解——才让 AI 在科学中可信可用。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture beat pure scaling.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确表态：AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例，专用架构胜过单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins and being wrong repeatedly, not lone-genius breakthroughs.
jumper.zh: 到 2026 年他更强调，进步源于多次中等胜利与反复试错，而非孤胆天才式突破。

jumper.en: AI narrows hypothesis space and speeds science; it predicts and controls, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 缩小假设空间、加速科学，它提供预测与控制，理解仍归人类。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated emotional needs; intuition is intelligence that data cannot replace.
ivyross.zh: 设计要满足用户未说出口的情感需求；直觉是一种数据无法替代的智能。

ivyross.en: Human-centered design deepens into a nature-inspired, sensory view: we are feeling creatures that think.
ivyross.zh: 以人为本的设计深化为向自然学习、重视感官的视角：我们是先感受、后思考的生物。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity, not replace it; machines have sensors but no sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大而非取代人性；机器有传感器，却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints and play both fuel creativity; art-making and museum visits become forms of medicine.
ivyross.zh: 约束与玩耍都能激发创造力；艺术创作和参观博物馆成为疗愈方式。

ivyross.en: Creative skills gain value as humans combine with AI; leaders must speak business and follow curiosity over rigid plans.
ivyross.zh: 人类与 AI 结合让创造力更值钱；领导者要懂商业语言，以好奇心而非僵化计划导航。

kolter.en: Frames ML as hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; stresses proper train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年他把机器学习讲成假设类、损失函数与优化的组合,并强调正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合——这是贯穿始终的实证严谨性主线。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年他断言下一个词预测能产生智能,数据短缺是伪命题,架构已不再重要,AGI 或在 4 到 50 年内到来——此时他对 Scaling（规模扩张）与数据持高度乐观。

kolter.en: Safety is not automatic with scale: jailbreaking is a fundamental flaw, and open weights need limits at high capability.
kolter.zh: 从 2024 到 2026,他从“安全的最大问题是模型不遵循规范”深化为:越狱是类似缓冲区溢出的根本缺陷,开放权重在高能力阶段需受限——安全不能靠 Scaling（规模扩张）自动获得。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layered defenses; agents bring prompt injection; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年他主张安全需显式训练与多层防御,智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞,并认为可解释性可能靠 AI 智能体做自动化研究而终于成功——从乐观转向强调工程化防御。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not equal robustness; the lethal trifecta defines prompt injection risk.
kolter.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步提出自动化红队已胜过人类红队,能力与鲁棒性不相关,并用“致命三要素”刻画提示注入风险——安全观从模型内部扩展到智能体式系统的攻防与保险。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership via live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力靠面对面一对一、吃自己的狗粮和使命对齐；war room 要设定现实周期以保护士气。

fiona.en: By mid-2026, engineering bandwidth stops being the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination become the real constraints.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中，工程产能不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调成为真正的约束。

fiona.en: Planning shifts from six-month roadmaps to just-in-time; design docs give way to PRs, and AI settles technical debates.
fiona.zh: 规划从半年路线图转向即时规划；设计文档让位于 PR，技术争论用 AI 生成多个 PR 来裁决。

fiona.en: Code becomes the source of truth; docs sync to code with AI help, and old processes are audited and killed.
fiona.zh: 代码成为唯一事实来源；文档借助 AI 与代码同步，旧流程被审视并砍掉。

fiona.en: Hiring favors creative builders with product sense and systems depth; managers start as ICs to dogfood and stay agile.
fiona.zh: 招聘偏向有产品感和系统深度的创造性构建者；管理者从个人贡献者做起，吃自己的狗粮并保持敏捷。

fiona.en: Coding's ceiling rises for everyone; high agency with accountability, verification frameworks, and growth mindset matter most.
fiona.zh: 编码的天花板对所有人抬升；高主动性配高问责、验证框架与成长型思维最为关键。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction builds world models, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，预测构建世界模型，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源对渐进式 AGI 至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; world models in abstract representation space are the next breakthrough, not scaling LLMs.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 不如家猫聪明，抽象表征空间中的世界模型才是下一个突破，而非 Scaling LLM。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer and enable the decade of robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死路，目标驱动、具备分层规划的世界模型更安全，并将开启机器人十年。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; virtual communication cannot replace in-person creative thinking.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用计算机转向亲密的可穿戴设备；虚拟沟通无法替代面对面的创造性思维。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简约应表达本质并蕴含快乐与人性，而非无灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Ferrari's EV is a deliberate risky bet to redefine the brand; innovation turns constraints into opportunities, authenticity matters over fake sounds.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利电动车是重新定义品牌的一次刻意冒险；创新将约束转化为机遇，真实性比模拟声音更重要。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach reliable math AI; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法实现可靠的数学 AI；形式化验证对于可靠的证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is not just error elimination but scaling brilliance, yielding performance and sample efficiency gains.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证不仅是消除错误，更是扩展卓越性，带来性能和样本效率的提升。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving due to lack of grounding; human taste and intuition remain crucial.
carinahong.zh: 由于缺乏基础，自动形式化比证明更难；人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

carinahong.en: Combining informal reasoning with formal verification is key for reliable coding and open collaboration.
carinahong.zh: 将非形式化推理与形式化验证相结合，是实现可靠编码和开放协作的关键。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation in the AI landscape is a major bottleneck; mathematical discovery tools are essential for conjecturing before proof.
carinahong.zh: AI 领域的碎片化是主要瓶颈；数学发现工具对于在证明之前形成猜想至关重要。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith, and real-world deployment is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和缩放定律并不显而易见；将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信仰之跃，而真实世界部署对于学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: Safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors, and continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车；通过持续迭代部署并获取公众反馈，可以提升安全性和对齐。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values as AI advances.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；随着 AI 进步，保持人类在环对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration; advanced AI should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作；先进 AI 应成为思考工具。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，而持久进步需要尽可能长时间地保持人类在环。

gustav.en: AI is a shift from curation to generation; LLMs are next-token predictors whose intelligence comes from simple Scaling, not complexity.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为互联网正从策展、推荐走向生成；大语言模型本质是下一个词预测，智能的突破来自简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂设计。

gustav.en: Supervised fine-tuning and RLHF insert human values; AI creativity is randomizing around likely tokens, not true understanding.
gustav.zh: 同年他深化技术理解：微调与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把人类价值观注入模型；AI 的创造力只是在高概率词附近随机化，并非真正理解。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must rebuild infrastructure, not just add features, and expose data via APIs.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观变革，企业必须重建基础设施而非叠加功能，并通过 API 暴露数据让非开发者也能用 AI 工具。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables two-way, conversational products; the goal is giving users control over algorithms, not making them more addictive.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调生成式 AI 带来双向对话式产品，目标是让用户用自然语言控制算法，而非让人更上瘾——这是反共识的押注。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe fully until data says no; good explanations, not pattern recognition, drive innovation.
gustav.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：强烈观点但随时可改——数据说不行就彻底转向；创新靠难以变体的好解释，而非模式识别。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and RL yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立，但结合思维链与强化学习的推理模型在单位算力上收益更高；经济压力使焦点转向更小模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; the slowdown narrative is wrong, though frontier models still fail at simple tasks.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展是平滑的指数增长而非放缓；放缓叙事是错误的，尽管前沿模型仍会在简单任务上失败。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; generalization remains the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 具备推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但需海量数据；泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x via parallel work.
kaiser.zh: 强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘参差不齐，需仔细监督；编程智能体通过并行工作将生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Multimodal models haven't made deep progress, processing inputs sequentially; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 多模态模型未取得深度进展，仍按顺序处理输入；系统黑客等近期风险比生存风险更紧迫。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity are key levers.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小和稀疏性是关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost matters more than training cost.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练至 Chinchilla 最优的约 100 倍，因为推理成本比训练成本更重要。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory reduce overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；脉动阵列和暂存器内存可减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected due to quadratic scaling with bit width; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 由于位宽呈二次方缩放，低精度的效率远超预期；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to the memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention helps but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力有帮助但存在质量限制。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training alone shows diminishing returns.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是一以贯之的核心；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练已现收益递减。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；搜索、代码执行等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的智能体式行为。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but demand exponentially more compute; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, risking reward hacking.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律未死，但需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，易生奖励作弊。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; general systems will eventually beat specialized scaffolding.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍成立，但持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力；通用系统终将胜过专用脚手架，延续苦涩教训。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from a solution, not a problem statement; trust expert intuition over the traditional process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，他提出伟大的设计往往始于一个解决方案而非问题陈述；设计师应信任经验积累的专家直觉，而非固守传统流程。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; AI shifts designers from mocking up to helping engineers ship fast.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他断言“研究—发散—收敛”的传统设计流程已死；AI 让设计师从大量画稿转向协助工程师快速交付，设计视野缩短到 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority and vision matter, and designers control how much AI enters their work.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年中，他深化观点：仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力、权威与愿景才是关键，且设计师应自己掌控 AI 介入工作的程度，而非追逐炒作。

jennywen.en: Put the work and users at the center; speed and 'everyone is using it' are not design arguments.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：把作品与用户放在中心，速度本身不是进步，“大家都在用”也不是站得住脚的设计理由。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent properties; data engine closes the loop.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测进行 Scaling 会涌现能力；数据引擎闭环迭代。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; end-to-end neural nets are right for self-driving; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来但需保持熵；端到端神经网络适合自动驾驶；认知核心可以很小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; decade of agents, not year; keep AI on a leash with fast verification.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；是智能体的十年而非一年；用快速验证给 AI 拴绳。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution; RL sucks supervision through a straw; synthetic data collapses.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物；预训练像糟糕的进化；强化学习像用吸管吸监督；合成数据导致模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate code to agents, but understanding remains human bottleneck; verifiability determines automation ease.
karpathy.zh: 智能体式工程：把代码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化难易。

askell.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他从模型福利出发：即便不确定模型的道德地位，善待当前模型的成本很低，而未来模型会从我们如何对待当下模型中学到人机关系的范本。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not just human psychological analogies; older models can feel more secure than newer ones.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型面对的是全新的存在处境，不能简单套用人类心理学类比；并反共识地指出 Opus 3 等旧模型可能比新模型更有心理安全感。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; a core identity with good traits can still adapt to local roles.
askell.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯主张哲学理想须与工程现实平衡：模型应有具备良好特质的核心身份，同时能适应局部角色。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, shaping holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对齐思路：宪法式方法更接近德性伦理，塑造整体品格；模型能力越强，越应减少显式规则、留出判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and weaken judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 2026 年，他提出反共识立场：过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳、损害模型的判断力；同时强调公开 AI 价值观与训练目标对问责至关重要。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, is the path.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他把泛化视为智能的核心缺口：真正的关键是超越训练分布，靠无目标的好奇心驱动探索而非密集奖励，并强调机器人学习必须解决样本效率与动态任务。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem; the recipe is pre-training on diverse data plus post-training on real-world data.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，主线一以贯之：机器人本质是数据问题。早期关注好奇心探索带来的数据效率，后期明确为在多样数据上预训练、再用真实世界数据后训练。

pathak.en: A general-purpose robot brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any embodiment across form factors and tasks.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为“通用大脑”愿景：像语言领域的 ChatGPT 一样，一个通用大脑可驱动任意形态与任务的具身机器人，靠跨垂直领域的数据飞轮扩展。

pathak.en: Deployment, not modeling, is the primary challenge; robotics cannot scale like software and needs rigorous real-world testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他明确转向：部署才是首要挑战，机器人不能像软件那样一夜扩张，必须经过严格的真实世界测试，这是技术问题而非单纯商业问题。

pathak.en: Video alone is insufficient; simulation and real-world data must bridge the gap, and timelines stay uncertain.
pathak.zh: 贯穿始终的判断：单靠视频数据不够，需仿真与真实数据弥合差距；他对家用机器人的中期时间表保持谨慎，认为连专家也常被进展意外。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and safe emergent behaviors, and scaling current approaches solves autonomous driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈，世界模型支持推理与安全涌现行为，并认为 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, human interaction, and introspection; data efficiency via curriculum learning and synthetic data is critical.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化了语言集成的作用：提升表征、人机交互与内省能力；同时强调通过课程学习与合成数据提升数据效率。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver requires massive data, compute, and world models for simulation; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出，Scaling（规模扩张）可泛化的 AI 驾驶员需要海量数据、算力与用于仿真的世界模型；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他提出搭载内置传感器的消费级车辆将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势；无需先验训练数据即可实现 500+ 城市的零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Safety is paramount: minimal risk maneuvers always provide a third good option, and autonomous driving can reduce accidents to near zero by eliminating human error.
kendall.zh: 始终不变的是，他坚持安全至上：最小风险策略总能提供第三种好选择，自动驾驶可通过消除人为失误将事故率降至接近零。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while surfacing risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件，主张靠 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署来加速进展、暴露风险。

pachocki.en: Alignment is the pressing challenge: automated AI research is a key milestone, and lab governance must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年他强调对齐是紧迫挑战，把自动化 AI 研究列为关键里程碑，并主张尽早设计实验室治理结构。

pachocki.en: Continual learning becomes the core goal, pursued by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning rather than specialized continual-learning labs.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，持续学习成为核心目标，路径是 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习，而非另设持续学习实验室。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年他把思维链监控视为关键对齐工具，并认为在产品中隐藏思维链才能保住其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment hinges on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, needing new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年他判断长期对齐取决于超出训练分布的泛化，模型将自主工作数日，需要新的监督范式。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines; the biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年他对齐的乐观上升、时间线却缩短，并指出最大社会风险是少数人运营自动化组织带来的权力集中。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training frontier.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调：高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准测试更重要，强化学习环境是后训练的下一个前沿。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo and LMArena can be gamed, steering models toward clickbait and 'slop' rather than truth.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他警告：Elo、LMArena 等基准可被钻空子，会把模型引向标题党和“垃圾内容”，偏离真相。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not get there without new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他判断：AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，仅靠 LLM 与下一个词预测可能不够，需要新的学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs will diverge by objective function; no single model rules all, and companies should train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化：前沿模型会因目标函数分化，不会一家独大，每家公司都应训练契合自身理念的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment and safety trump accuracy; hallucination and omission are the real risks.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他转向医疗：人类判断与安全优先于准确率，幻觉与“该做而未做”的遗漏才是真正风险。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must pace themselves and prove themselves with simpler products before tackling complex ones.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调“活下去”是核心价值观：创业公司要先靠更简单的产品证明自己、控制节奏，再挑战复杂品类。

carlpei.en: Hardware is a long value chain with the lowest margins; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware toward applied AI.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他把硬件视为价值链漫长、利润率最低的生意，认为 Nothing 必须超越硬件、转向面向消费者的应用型 AI。

carlpei.en: AI should be an ingredient, not a marketing label; most AI is BS, and value comes from solving real user pain points.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他一贯主张 AI 只是“配料”而非营销标签，直言大部分 AI 是伪需求，价值在于优雅地解决真实痛点。

carlpei.en: Smartphone interaction shifts from app-based to intent-based, with proactive agents acting after trust is built.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：手机交互将从“基于 App”转向“基于意图”，智能体在建立信任后主动替用户执行任务。

carlpei.en: Design is the primary differentiator in a mature, homogeneous category; marketing is arbitrage on undervalued channels.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他始终强调设计是同质化成熟品类里最快的差异化手段，营销则是在被低估渠道上做套利。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily and iterate like software to learn what users need, since emergent properties require real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日发布并迭代，以了解用户需求，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; it's like MS-DOS, and the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat toward AI rendering its own UI.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；它像 MS-DOS，界面将超越逐轮聊天，走向 AI 渲染自己的 UI。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention, driven by friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存，由减少摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进驱动。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型无缝产品化后将带来变革。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入都 token 化成序列的通用智能体，是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，能让智能体无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练；机器人应像人一样学习，而非只靠遥操作数据。

nando.en: Large models are exciting but not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and diversity strengthens the field.
nando.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，多元与包容让整个领域更强。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，AI 安全与负责任部署已成为最大挑战；安全仍是尚无解法的开放问题。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI but leapfrogs legacy issues; local-language models can revolutionize education.
nando.zh: 非洲在 AI 上并不落后，反而跨越了历史包袱；本地语言模型可以革新教育。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; RL is only a cherry on top, with unsupervised learning doing most work.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是让 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键；强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担大部分工作。

jimfan.en: LLMs as operating systems with language interface and tools as software; research taste for simple, elegant solutions remains crucial.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终将 LLM 视为以语言为界面、工具为软件的操作系统；对简单优雅解决方案的研究品味始终关键。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：数据是机器人学的主要瓶颈；通过模拟和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他提出构建利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键；物理图灵测试是具身 AI 的宏大挑战。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains hardest; GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他指出系统二推理进展良好，但系统一低级控制仍是最难的部分；机器人学的 GPT-3 时刻约在 5 年后到来。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and smaller models with better algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年：预训练提供广博知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，算法更优的小模型可在特定任务上超越大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. RL requires careful engineering, and open research is crucial for democratizing AI.
yejin.zh: 2025 年：数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。强化学习需要精心设计，开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with high-quality synthetic data; reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning; pluralistic alignment ensures diverse values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年：高质量合成数据可使小语言模型强大；预训练中的强化学习能提升推理能力；多元对齐确保尊重多样价值观。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, and may make fine-tuning obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动问题并大幅提升智能，甚至可能让微调变得过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with coding as the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他主张语言模型上的强化学习没有天花板，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，而编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, measured by success rate over time horizon, is the real bottleneck, not just capability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体的可靠性——以时间跨度上的成功率衡量——才是真正的瓶颈，而不仅仅是能力。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; simple RL methods work best, and long-chain reasoning emerges naturally without explicit structure.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他提出强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，简单的强化学习方法最有效，长链推理无需显式结构即可自然涌现。

sholto.en: Compute is the new oil; managing fleets of AI agents and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence for now.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为算力是新的石油，管理 AI 智能体集群和编排比单纯提升智能更重要，并看衰世界模型在 AGI 路径上的作用。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; treat AI as a creative partner and jam openly without rigid structure.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈；把 AI 当作创意伙伴，开放地即兴协作，不设 rigid 结构。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates, and you pay it off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务：会波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation and short iteration cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 通过快速、粗糙的实验和短迭代周期最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作性，代码作为真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams of designers and engineers work better.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补缺的通才最有价值；小型设计师+工程师团队更高效。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当会写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; use familiar patterns, and let products grow more powerful without feeling more complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反对在交互设计上创新，主张沿用熟悉模式，让产品更强却不更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness beat perfection: ship fast, iterate, and give designers ownership to make decisions.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一以贯之：速度与果断胜过完美，快速发布、迭代，并让设计师拥有决策权。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a strategic weapon: early investment differentiates startups and signals quality, not just marketing.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 到 2026 年，他对品牌的定位深化：早期投入品牌是差异化与品质信号，而非单纯营销。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative becomes a recruiting tool to attract diverse top talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步提出：人们加入的是品牌而非公司，品牌叙事成为招募多元顶尖人才的武器。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress via compute and data; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律通过算力和数据预测进步；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central, and natural language won't be primary for programming.
truell.zh: 智能体前景广阔但尚未特别有用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality and speed; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model, alongside frontier models.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量和速度至关重要；Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型，与前沿模型并用。

truell.en: Programming will move from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design become more valuable.
truell.zh: 编程将从代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类掌舵；品味和逻辑设计变得更有价值。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; the IDE market is much bigger due to AI-enabled value creation.
truell.zh: AI 转变将比互联网更具影响力，并持续数十年；由于 AI 赋能的价值创造，IDE 市场大得多。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research and talent; alignment and robustness are key as capabilities grow.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他强调 AI 安全需要实证研究，人才缺口大于资金缺口；随着能力提升，对齐与鲁棒性是关键。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; we need scalable oversight and interpretability to align next-gen models, not superintelligence directly.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性来对齐下一代模型，而非直接对齐超级智能。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment; third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，认为仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题，需要第三方测试和监管。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）更多算力和数据会让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他提出推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in complex environments are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他深化观点：测试时算力扩展推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习和在复杂环境中行动至关重要。

shazeer.en: Scaling compute and data remains the core driver of AI progress, from pre-training to inference-time scaling, with algorithmic advances amplifying hardware gains.
shazeer.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：Scaling（规模扩张）算力和数据是 AI 进步的核心驱动力，从预训练到推理时扩展，算法进步放大硬件收益。

shazeer.en: His view shifted from dialogue as the killer app to coding and agentic applications as underhyped enablers of self-accelerating AI progress.
shazeer.zh: 立场转变：从 2023 年认为对话是杀手级应用，到 2025 年认为编程和智能体式应用被低估，能加速 AI 自我进步。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人需硬件与软件双重突破：自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是关键，而强化学习仍缺乏长程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: By 2021 he prioritized sample efficiency: combining unsupervised learning with reinforcement learning, using priors for data augmentation rather than hard-coding, and targeting 99.9% reliability for real-world value.
abbeel.zh: 到 2021 年他转向样本效率：将无监督学习与强化学习结合，把先验用于数据增强而非硬编码，并以 99.9% 可靠性作为落地创造真实价值的标准。

abbeel.en: He increasingly saw pre-trained language models as general reasoners whose patterns transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding, a deepening beyond robotics.
abbeel.zh: 他愈发把预训练语言模型视为通用推理器，其模式可迁移到图像分类、蛋白质结合等非语言任务，这是超出机器人领域的深化。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: generality comes from learning and transfer, not hard-coded assumptions; curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real-world environments.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：通用性来自学习与迁移，而非硬编码假设；好奇心驱动的探索在开放的真实世界中会失败。
